66452.recognize_zh: 一顆比周圍紅血球大數倍的紅系前驅細胞，核大而圓、染色質細緻，細胞質深藍色並向外突出成「狗耳朵」狀突起 (dog-ear projections)，即巨大前紅血球母細胞 (giant pronormoblast)，是 parvovirus B19 感染的線索。
features: Single markedly enlarged erythroid precursor, roughly 3–4 times the diameter of surrounding red cells
Large round nucleus occupying most of the cell, with finely granular, evenly dispersed magenta chromatin
Distinct intranuclear inclusion is not clearly resolved on this image
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm forming bulbous blebs/pseudopod-like 'dog-ear' projections at the cell margin
Image is out of focus with a yellow-green cast, limiting assessment of nucleoli and inclusions
66452.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a giant erythroid precursor with a large round nucleus, finely dispersed chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm bearing prominent cytoplasmic blebs (dog-ear projections). A discrete eosinophilic intranuclear inclusion cannot be confidently identified because of limited image focus and color balance. No maturing erythroid precursors are present in this field. The morphology is consistent with a giant pronormoblast, suggestive of parvovirus B19 infection; correlation with reticulocytopenia and B19 PCR or immunohistochemistry is recommended.

ddx.vs: Normal pronormoblasts are about 15–20 µm with visible nucleoli and lack the gigantic size and glassy intranuclear inclusion of B19-infected cells.
Leukemic proerythroblasts occur in sheets with nucleoli and often cytoplasmic vacuoles, whereas B19 produces isolated giant cells in a background of erythroid hypoplasia.
Megaloblasts show open sieve-like chromatin across all maturation stages with erythroid hyperplasia rather than isolated giant early precursors.
Megakaryoblasts also have cytoplasmic blebs but are CD61 positive, and plasmablasts have a perinuclear hof; confirmation relies on CD71/E-cadherin versus CD61 or CD138 staining.

65876.recognize_zh: 多圖組合：A、D 母細胞增多並夾雜含粗大深紫色嗜鹼性顆粒的母細胞與嗜鹼性前驅細胞，D 小圖鐵染色見環狀鐵粒母細胞；B、C 為流式（CD34+ 母細胞、CD22+ 子群），E 為光學基因體圖譜的複雜核型 circos 圖，整體指向 TP53 突變、治療相關 AML 伴嗜鹼性分化。
features: Panels A and D: increased medium-to-large blasts with fine chromatin, several containing coarse dark purple basophilic granules, plus basophilic myeloid precursors
Panel D inset (Perls): erythroid precursors with perinuclear iron granules consistent with ring sideroblasts
Panel B: CD34-positive blast gate comprising about 78% of events on CD34 versus FSC
Panel C: a small CD22-positive, CD34-positive subset (about 6.6%) corresponding to basophil-lineage blasts
Panel E: circos plot from optical genome mapping with multiple interchromosomal links indicating a highly complex karyotype
65876.describe_en: Peripheral blood and bone marrow aspirate smears (panels A and D) show increased blasts with fine chromatin, a subset of which contain coarse dark basophilic granules, together with increased basophilic myeloid precursors and basophils; the Perls-stained inset demonstrates ring sideroblasts. Flow cytometry (panels B and C) shows a predominant CD34-positive blast population with a minor CD22-positive subset, consistent with basophilic differentiation given the CD123-bright/CD13/CD33/CD11b profile described. The optical genome mapping circos plot (panel E) shows numerous structural rearrangements, indicating a complex karyotype. In the setting of prior chemotherapy and biallelic TP53 mutation, findings are consistent with therapy-related acute myeloid leukemia with mutated TP53, with basophilic differentiation and ring sideroblasts.

ddx.vs: This is the classic AML with basophilia and ring sideroblasts, and is separated by the specific translocation rather than a TP53-mutated complex karyotype.
Acute basophilic leukemia is a diagnosis of exclusion that cannot be made when a defining genetic abnormality such as mutated TP53 or therapy relation is present.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia in blast phase
ddx.vs: CML-BP also shows marked basophilia but carries BCR::ABL1, which must be excluded by FISH or PCR.
CD22 on basophil-lineage blasts is lineage-infidelity without CD19, CD79a or CD10, so B-lineage criteria are not met.

65812.recognize_zh: 在滿是骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞與分節嗜中性球的背景中，可看到兩顆佈滿深紫黑色粗顆粒的嗜鹼性球（basophil）及嗜伊紅性球，嗜鹼性球增多配合完整的顆粒球左移，是 CML 的關鍵線索。
features: Marked leukocytosis with the full range of granulocyte maturation (promyelocyte to segmented neutrophil)
Two basophils with dense dark purple-black granules obscuring the nucleus
Eosinophils, including one with orange granules and a bilobed nucleus (left) and an eosinophilic myelocyte (top)
Cluster of myelocytes and a promyelocyte with round nuclei, fine to moderately condensed chromatin and granular cytoplasm
No increase in blasts and no granulocytic dysplasia in this field
Background platelets; red cells with mild anisocytosis
65812.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis composed of granulocytes at all stages of maturation, including promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils. Basophils and eosinophils are both increased, with two basophils and eosinophilic forms present in this single field. Blasts are not increased and granulocytes show no dysplasia. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive, chronic phase.

ddx.vs: Absolute basophilia is not a feature of reactive neutrophilia, which instead shows toxic granulation and Dohle bodies.
Progression is suggested by basophils of 20% or more or rising blasts, which require a differential count rather than a single field.
aCML has dysplastic neutrophils and minimal basophilia, unlike the orderly maturation and basophilia shown.
PMF shows a leukoerythroblastic smear with teardrop cells and nucleated red cells and a much lower white count.

65684.recognize_zh: 血片中一條彎曲的長形線蟲幼蟲，體內充滿紫色核柱，兩端都可見淡粉紅色、空的鞘延伸出蟲體之外；有鞘且彎曲平順，符合夜間出現的淋巴絲蟲微絲蚴。
features: Large elongated microfilaria, many times the diameter of surrounding cells, lying in smooth open curves
Body filled with a column of basophilic nuclei
Pink, empty sheath clearly extending beyond both ends of the larva, with transverse folds at one end
Tail end nuclei and cephalic space cannot be assessed reliably at this magnification
Background of clumped, partially lysed blood cells typical of a thick or dense smear
65684.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large sheathed microfilaria lying in smooth curves among clumped blood cells. The body contains a column of basophilic nuclei, and a pink-staining empty sheath projects beyond both ends of the organism. The arrangement of the terminal tail nuclei is not clearly resolved in this image, precluding definitive species assignment on morphology alone. Findings are consistent with microfilaremia due to a sheathed lymphatic filarial species, most likely Wuchereria bancrofti in an endemic setting with nocturnal sampling.

ddx.vs: B. malayi shows kinky secondary curves, crowded nuclei and two isolated terminal tail nuclei, with a sheath that stains deeply pink on Giemsa.
Loa loa is sheathed but its nuclei extend to the tip of the tail and it circulates in daytime blood.
Mansonella microfilariae are smaller and unsheathed.
Fibers lack internal nuclei, a sheath and defined anterior and posterior ends.

65236.recognize_zh: 骨髓造血組織被纖維化（desmoplastic）間質取代，其中散布小巢狀、條索狀的上皮細胞群，細胞核大、有核仁、彼此擠在一起，周圍常有收縮空隙；這種黏聚的非造血腫瘤巢是轉移性乳腺管癌的表現。
features: Small cohesive nests and cords of epithelial cells within desmoplastic fibrous stroma
Tumor cells with enlarged, pleomorphic, hyperchromatic nuclei and visible nucleoli
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm with nuclear crowding and overlap
Peritumoral retraction clefts around nests
Normal hematopoietic elements replaced by fibroblastic stroma with small vessels
65236.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows marrow spaces replaced by desmoplastic fibrous stroma containing small cohesive nests and cords of epithelial cells. The tumor cells have enlarged pleomorphic nuclei with coarse chromatin, visible nucleoli, and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, and many nests are surrounded by retraction clefts. Normal hematopoietic elements are not identified in this field. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma, in keeping with the patient's known invasive ductal carcinoma of the breast; confirmatory immunohistochemistry (e.g., cytokeratin, GATA3, HER2) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Lobular carcinoma infiltrates as discohesive single cells or single files and is E-cadherin negative, unlike these cohesive nests.
Morphology overlaps, so site of origin requires IHC such as GATA3/ER/HER2 for breast versus TTF-1, CDX2 or NKX3.1.
Megakaryocytes are large single cells with lobulated nuclei and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, CD61-positive and keratin-negative.
Myeloma forms discohesive sheets of plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei that are CD138-positive and keratin-negative, without desmoplastic nests.

65300.recognize_zh: 淋巴球大小不一，許多細胞質豐富、核有深切跡或摺疊（cleaved/indented），左上與下方有 smudge cell，整體偏向 CLL 伴 trisomy 12 的非典型形態，而非小而圓核、染色質呈塊狀的典型 CLL。
features: Numerous small-to-medium lymphocytes with heterogeneous size
Moderate to abundant pale cytoplasm in many cells
Deeply indented, folded and cleaved nuclear contours
Moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli generally inconspicuous
Smudge cells present (upper left and lower right)
Occasional granulocyte with fine cytoplasmic granules for comparison
65300.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a marked lymphocytosis with cells of varying size. Many lymphocytes have moderate to abundant pale cytoplasm and irregular, deeply indented or cleaved nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin, and smudge cells are present. Large cells with prominent central nucleoli are not conspicuous. These features represent atypical CLL morphology associated with trisomy 12; immunophenotyping and FISH (CCND1 break-apart or t(11;14)) are advised to exclude mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Cleaved nuclei raise MCL, which is excluded by CD23 positivity and absence of cyclin D1/SOX11 expression and t(11;14).
FL cells are small with sharply cleft ('buttock') nuclei and scant cytoplasm and are CD10-positive, CD5-negative.
Sezary cells have cerebriform nuclear folding and a CD4-positive T-cell phenotype rather than a CD5+/CD23+ B-cell phenotype.

65172.recognize_zh: 這張圖並非形態影像，而且只呈現 A 格的正常紅血球體積直方圖示意（單一對稱峰、MCV 與 RDW 標示、60/120 fL 虛線），標題所說的「隨時間變化」序列（B 格）不在此圖中。
features: Schematic normal RBC volume histogram (panel A only) with frequency versus cell volume in fL
Single symmetric unimodal peak near 90 fL indicating the MCV
Double-headed arrow across the curve denoting the RDW
Solid lines bounding the central 92% of the red cell population
Dashed lines at 60 fL and 120 fL defining microcytic and macrocytic fractions
65172.describe_en: This figure is a non-morphologic schematic showing only panel A, a normal impedance red cell volume histogram, although the title refers to serial histograms over time. The curve is a single symmetric population centered around 90 fL, with the MCV marked at the peak and the RDW as the distribution width. Solid lines mark the central 92% of cells, and dashed lines at 60 and 120 fL quantify microcytic and macrocytic fractions. In TTP, comparison with this reference would reveal a microcytic tail from schistocytes early and a macrocytic reticulocyte shoulder during recovery, but those serial curves are not included in this image.

65108.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片 100 倍：中央一顆大型細胞，細胞質豐富且呈深藍嗜鹼性，核偏心、染色質細緻並可見核仁，核旁細胞質稍淡，屬於循環中的漿母細胞（plasmablast），背景紅血球無特殊。
features: Single large cell, roughly twice the diameter of a red cell
Eccentric round nucleus with fine to slightly granular chromatin and a visible nucleolus
Abundant intensely basophilic (royal blue) cytoplasm with a paler perinuclear area
Irregular cytoplasmic outline without granules or vacuoles
Background red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis and some crenation; no other leukocytes in the field
65108.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at 100x shows a single large circulating cell with an eccentric round nucleus, fine chromatin, a visible nucleolus and abundant intensely basophilic cytoplasm with a paler perinuclear zone. The cytoplasm is agranular with a slightly irregular border. Background red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis and crenation. Findings are consistent with a circulating plasmablast; a single cell is non-specific, but in the clinical context supports HHV8-associated multicentric Castleman disease.

ddx.vs: Immunoblasts have a central nucleus with deep blue cytoplasm lacking a perinuclear hof, and occur with other reactive lymphocytes, though distinction from a plasmablast can be subjective.
Mature plasma cells have clumped clock-face chromatin without a nucleolus and a smaller size, whereas this cell has fine chromatin and a nucleolus.
Proerythroblasts have a more central nucleus, deep blue cytoplasm with blebs and no perinuclear clearing, and are rare in blood outside of severe hemolysis or leukoerythroblastosis.

64980.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中央一條血管管腔被粉紅色纖維化組織完全填滿，只剩幾個小裂隙狀的再通管道（recanalization），周圍是細胞密度高的造血組織，符合已機化的血栓性血管阻塞。
features: Medium-sized marrow blood vessel with lumen occluded by concentric eosinophilic fibrocellular tissue
Scattered small slit-like and round vascular channels within the plug, consistent with recanalization
Spindle and plump fibroblast-like nuclei within the organized thrombus
Surrounding hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoietic cells
No inflammatory infiltrate of the vessel wall or granulomas in this field
64980.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy (H&E) shows a medium-sized blood vessel whose lumen is occluded by organized fibrocellular eosinophilic material containing several small recanalized vascular channels. The surrounding marrow is hypercellular with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis. There is no vasculitis or tumor embolus identified in this field. Findings are consistent with an organized, recanalized thrombus within a marrow vessel, compatible with thrombotic microangiopathy of catastrophic antiphospholipid antibody syndrome in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.vs: Tumor emboli contain cohesive atypical epithelial or malignant cells rather than bland fibroblastic tissue with recanalized channels.
Vasculitis shows transmural inflammatory infiltrate and fibrinoid necrosis of the wall, which is absent here.
Hyaline arteriolosclerosis thickens the wall with homogeneous hyaline while the lumen remains patent and narrowed rather than plugged with recanalized tissue.
Acute microthrombi are small, fresh eosinophilic fibrin/platelet plugs without organization or recanalization; distinction from APS requires antiphospholipid antibody testing.

64724.recognize_zh: 臨床照片中胸腹部皮膚廣泛散布數十個膚色至粉紅色、表面光滑的圓頂狀丘疹與小結節，大小不一，少數有結痂，無水泡或鱗屑；在復發 AML 病人身上應懷疑白血病皮膚浸潤（leukemia cutis）。
features: Numerous discrete, dome-shaped, smooth papules and small nodules widely distributed over the chest and abdomen
Skin-colored to pink, translucent-appearing lesions varying from 1 mm to several millimeters
Occasional small hyperpigmented crusts/excoriations; no vesicles, pustules or scale
No ulceration, purpura, or confluent plaques
64724.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the anterior trunk shows a widespread eruption of numerous discrete, dome-shaped, smooth, skin-colored to pink papules and small nodules of varying size. A few lesions show small dark crusts, but there are no vesicles, pustules, scale, ulceration, or purpura. This clinical appearance is nonspecific; in a patient with relapsed refractory AML with t(10;11)(p11.2;q23) two weeks after second remission, it is suggestive of leukemia cutis indicating extramedullary relapse, to be confirmed by skin biopsy.

ddx.vs: Viral eruptions evolve through vesicles and crusts in crops, and biopsy shows viral cytopathic effect rather than a dermal blast infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Disseminated candidiasis or other fungal infection
ddx.vs: Fungal papules are often erythematous with central necrosis or pustules in neutropenic patients, and biopsy shows yeasts/hyphae on PAS/GMS.
Eruptive xanthomas are yellow-orange papules on extensor surfaces with hypertriglyceridemia and foamy histiocytes on biopsy.
These require biopsy with immunophenotyping, as BPDCN is CD123/TCF4+ and CTCL shows epidermotropic T cells, whereas AML cutis expresses MPO/lysozyme/CD33.

64468.recognize_zh: 四格影像中皆可見緊密聚集的小圓形囊體，囊壁呈淡色光暈、中央有深色點狀內容物（囊內體），嵌在淡粉紫色的泡沫狀基質內，大小遠小於旁邊的白血球，符合肺囊蟲囊體簇。
features: Tight clusters of small, uniform round cysts (roughly 5 µm) with refractile pale walls
Dark central dot-like or crescent-shaped intracystic bodies within many cysts
Clusters embedded in pale pink-purple foamy/amorphous matrix
Adjacent leukocytes much larger than the cysts; no budding or hyphae
Variable stain color across panels and soft focus limit fine detail
64468.describe_en: Sputum smear (composite of four fields) shows tight aggregates of small, uniform, round cyst-like structures with pale refractile walls and dark dot-like internal bodies, embedded in a foamy amorphous matrix. The structures are much smaller than adjacent leukocytes, and no budding or hyphal forms are seen. Image focus limits assessment of fine detail. Findings are consistent with Pneumocystis jirovecii cysts, best confirmed with GMS stain, immunofluorescence, or PCR.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are usually intracellular within macrophages and show narrow-based budding, rather than extracellular foamy clusters.
Cryptococcus is larger and more variable in size with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule and narrow-based budding.

ddx.dx: Red blood cells or starch/pollen contaminants
ddx.vs: Red cells lack internal dots, and starch granules or pollen are larger, variable, and show Maltese cross or ornamented walls.

64404.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的分葉核中性球，整個細胞質佈滿粗大、深紫色的顆粒，比正常中性球的細小淡染顆粒更粗更密，這就是中毒性顆粒（toxic granulation）。
features: Mature neutrophil with a multilobed (segmented) nucleus
Cytoplasm densely filled with coarse, dark purple (azurophilic) granules
Granules larger and more intensely staining than normal neutrophilic granules, obscuring the pale cytoplasm
No Dohle bodies or cytoplasmic vacuoles clearly identified in this cell
Background red cells in overlapping area with scattered normal platelets
64404.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil (arrow) whose cytoplasm is densely packed with coarse, dark purple azurophilic granules that are larger and darker than normal secondary granules. Dohle bodies and vacuolization are not clearly identified in this cell. Platelets are present and red cells are unremarkable in this field. Findings are consistent with toxic granulation, a reactive change associated with infection, inflammation or G-CSF therapy.

ddx.vs: Alder-Reilly granules are large dark granules present in all leukocyte lineages including lymphocytes and monocytes, and occur without an infectious context.
Chediak-Higashi shows few giant, irregular pink-gray to purple inclusions rather than numerous uniformly coarse granules.
Overstaining darkens granules in all neutrophils and other cells uniformly, including red cells and background, whereas toxic granulation varies from cell to cell.
Basophil granules are larger, blue-black, water-soluble and overlie the nucleus, which is usually less segmented.

64148.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結可見被膜下一大片淡粉紅色、細胞稀少的壞死區，周圍是保留的淋巴細胞，壞死區中已可看到零星深藍紫色不規則團塊；在年輕女性的無膿性壞死中找到 hematoxylin body，支持狼瘡淋巴結病。
features: Low-power lymph node with capsule at the upper right
Large, geographic, pale eosinophilic paracortical zone of necrosis with karyorrhectic debris
Scattered small irregular deep basophilic amorphous bodies within the necrotic zone
Surrounding preserved sheets of small lymphocytes with patent sinuses
Neutrophilic abscess formation and granulomas not evident at this magnification
64148.describe_en: Lymph node section at low power shows a large geographic area of pale eosinophilic necrosis within the paracortex, bordered by preserved sheets of small lymphocytes, with the capsule seen at the upper right. Within the necrotic area are scattered karyorrhectic debris and irregular, deeply basophilic amorphous bodies consistent with hematoxylin bodies. There is no apparent abscess formation or granulomatous inflammation at this magnification. Findings are consistent with necrotizing lymphadenitis of systemic lupus erythematosus; higher power evaluation and immunostains are needed to exclude lymphoma and Kikuchi disease.

ddx.vs: Shares paracortical non-neutrophilic necrosis at low power, but hematoxylin bodies, plasma cells, and vasculitis favor lupus, supported by ANA/anti-dsDNA serology.
Viable tumor at the edge of necrosis consists of sheets of atypical cells with a clonal immunophenotype, not the small reactive lymphocytes seen here.
Infarction produces ghost outlines of the entire node with a peripheral granulation-tissue rim, rather than a focal paracortical necrosis with hematoxylin bodies.
These show caseating or stellate suppurative necrosis surrounded by palisading epithelioid histiocytes and neutrophils.

64020.recognize_zh: 這是右大腿 CT 冠狀／矢狀重建影像：股骨近端內側、鄰近坐骨與恥骨下枝處有一團邊界不規則、密度等同骨皮質的高密度鈣化／骨化塊，周圍軟組織腫脹；在血友病 A 病人，符合肌肉內出血後的異位性骨化（heterotopic ossification）。
features: Contrast-enhanced CT reformatted image of the right thigh and pelvis (superior marked 'S')
Large lobulated, densely calcified/ossified mass with bone-density attenuation in the proximal medial thigh adjacent to the ischium and pubic ramus
Mottled internal architecture with a peripheral dense rim, suggesting mature ossification
Surrounding thigh musculature appears bulky without a large enhancing soft-tissue component on this slice
Distal femur visible at the knee; this single slice does not fully show the described bridging to the femoral metaphysis
64020.describe_en: Reformatted CT image of the right thigh shows a large lobulated mass of bone-like attenuation in the proximal medial thigh adjacent to the ischium and inferior pubic ramus, with a dense peripheral rim and mottled internal ossification. There is no large associated enhancing soft-tissue mass on this slice, and the bridging to the medial femoral metaphysis described clinically is not fully captured in this single image. This is a radiologic, non-morphologic figure. In a patient with hemophilia A, findings are consistent with heterotopic ossification, likely following recurrent intramuscular hemorrhage.

ddx.vs: Pseudotumors are encapsulated expanding hematomas with low-to-mixed attenuation contents, bone erosion and a thin calcified rim rather than a solid mature ossified mass.
Osteosarcoma shows denser central mineralization with an immature periphery, cortical invasion or a soft-tissue component, opposite to the zonal peripheral maturation of heterotopic ossification.
Radiologically identical zonal ossification, distinguished only by the clinical history of trauma versus coagulopathy-related bleeding.

ddx.dx: Calcified chronic hematoma or tumoral calcinosis
ddx.vs: Dystrophic calcification lacks trabecular bone architecture and a corticated rim.

63892.recognize_zh: 腎臟切片 H&E 可見小型藍色腫瘤細胞在腎小管之間瀰漫浸潤；免疫染色 CD45 陰性、CD19 陰性、CD34 陰性，但 PAX5、TdT、CD10、CD43 陽性，TdT 與 PAX5 陽性確立為 B 淋巴母細胞，屬罕見的 CD45−/CD19− 表型 B-ALL。
features: H&E (A): diffuse infiltrate of small round blue cells with scant cytoplasm surrounding and separating renal tubules
CD45 (B): negative in tumor cells, with only scattered positive background cells; flow inset of CD45-negative gate
CD43 (C) and CD10 (E): strong diffuse positivity (CD10 also highlights tubules)
CD19 (D) and CD34 (F): negative in the neoplastic cells
PAX5 (G): strong nuclear positivity; TdT (H): diffuse nuclear positivity
Image resolution is low, limiting cytologic detail
63892.describe_en: Composite figure of a renal needle core biopsy. The H&E section shows a diffuse interstitial infiltrate of monotonous small round blue cells with scant cytoplasm dissecting between renal tubules. By immunohistochemistry the neoplastic cells are negative for CD45, CD19 and CD34, and positive for CD43, CD10, PAX5 and TdT; the flow cytometry inset shows a CD45-negative population. Low image resolution limits cytologic assessment. The TdT positivity establishes a precursor lymphoid neoplasm and PAX5 supports B lineage despite loss of CD45 and CD19. Findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with an unusual CD45-negative, CD19-negative immunophenotype.

ddx.vs: Ewing sarcoma is also a CD45-negative, CD99-positive small round cell tumor but is TdT- and PAX5-negative and carries an EWSR1 rearrangement.
These are CD43/TdT/PAX5-negative and express neural markers (PHOX2B, synaptophysin) or WT1 with epithelial/stromal differentiation.
Burkitt lymphoma is CD10-positive and PAX5-positive but TdT-negative, expresses CD20 and surface immunoglobulin, and shows a starry-sky pattern with MYC rearrangement.
T-LBL is TdT-positive and may be CD43/CD10-positive but lacks PAX5 and expresses cytoplasmic CD3.

63892.stain: H&E; IHC: CD45, CD43, CD19, CD10, CD34, PAX5, TdT

63764.recognize_zh: 低倍下白血球明顯增多，以小型淋巴球為主並可見被推破的破碎細胞（smudge cell，箭頭）；高倍下淋巴球小而成熟、核圓、染色質粗塊狀（龜殼樣），符合慢性淋巴球性白血病（CLL）。
features: Marked absolute lymphocytosis at low power
Predominantly small mature lymphocytes with round nuclei, coarse clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Numerous smudge cells (arrows)
Occasional slightly larger lymphocytes with more abundant pale cytoplasm
Red cells normocytic without significant poikilocytosis; platelets present
63764.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, in a composite of low- and high-power views, shows marked lymphocytosis composed predominantly of small mature-appearing lymphocytes with round nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm. Frequent smudge cells are present (arrows). A minority of lymphocytes are slightly larger with more abundant cytoplasm, but prolymphocytes with prominent nucleoli are not conspicuous. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable. Findings are suggestive of chronic lymphocytic leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD5+, CD23+, CD200+, dim CD20 and dim light chain) is required.

ddx.vs: Cells often have irregular or cleaved nuclei and fewer smudge cells, and are CD23 and CD200 negative with cyclin D1/SOX11 and t(11;14).
Shows a heterogeneous mix of reactive or cleaved lymphocytes and polyclonal flow cytometry.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic transformation / CLL with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: Many medium-sized cells with a single prominent central nucleolus, absent here.
Villous lymphocytes with polar cytoplasmic projections and a CD5-negative, CD23-negative phenotype.

63636.recognize_zh: 右上方一群嗜中性球（neutrophil）的細胞膜外緣一圈圈黏附著許多小紫色血小板，像花環一樣環繞每顆嗜中性球，而其他背景的血小板很少，這就是血小板衛星現象（platelet satellitism）。
features: Cluster of six segmented/band neutrophils with normal nuclear and granular morphology
Numerous small purple platelets adhering in a ring around the cell membrane of each neutrophil (rosetting)
Few free platelets in the remainder of the field, explaining a falsely low automated count
Normocytic red cells without significant poikilocytosis
63636.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of neutrophils, each surrounded by a rim of adherent platelets forming rosettes around the cell membrane. The neutrophils themselves are morphologically unremarkable, and relatively few free platelets are present elsewhere in the field. Red cells are normocytic without significant poikilocytosis. Findings are consistent with platelet satellitism, an EDTA-dependent in vitro phenomenon that can cause spurious thrombocytopenia; a repeat count in citrate or heparin anticoagulant or a fingerstick smear is recommended.

ddx.vs: Pseudothrombocytopenia from clumping shows free aggregates of platelets in the background and feathered edge rather than platelets encircling neutrophils.
True thrombocytopenia shows reduced platelets throughout the smear with no rosettes, and the count does not correct in citrate.
Phagocytosed platelets lie within the neutrophil cytoplasm, whereas satellite platelets adhere to the outer membrane.

63572.recognize_zh: 紅血球成不規則葡萄串狀聚集（agglutination），不是錢串狀（rouleaux）的線性堆疊，加上兩顆胞質稍多、核染色質粗的淋巴球，提示冷凝集素病合併淋巴增生疾病。
features: Irregular three-dimensional clumps of red cells (agglutinates) scattered throughout the thin area of the film
Agglutinates are random clusters rather than linear coin-stack rouleaux
Two small to medium lymphoid cells with round nuclei, clumped chromatin and a thin rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Occasional polychromatic cell within an agglutinate; spherocytes not prominent
Platelets present, not clumped
63572.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows prominent red cell agglutination, with irregular clusters of erythrocytes distributed throughout the monolayer rather than linear rouleaux. Two small to intermediate lymphoid cells with condensed chromatin and a modest rim of basophilic cytoplasm are present; distinct plasmacytoid features are subtle at this magnification. No blasts are seen. Findings are consistent with cold agglutinin-mediated red cell agglutination; in context, suggestive of cold agglutinin disease secondary to a lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma, which requires confirmation by DAT (C3d+), cold agglutinin titer, serum protein electrophoresis, and flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux form linear stacks like coins and do not disperse on warming or saline replacement, whereas agglutinates are irregular clumps that disperse at 37 C.
Warm AIHA shows spherocytes without prominent agglutination and a DAT positive for IgG rather than C3d only.
CLL shows numerous small lymphocytes with soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells, and a CD5+/CD23+ phenotype rather than CD5-negative lymphoplasmacytic cells with MYD88 L265P.

63316.recognize_zh: 四格骨髓抹片中可見大型、染色質呈篩網狀的巨母紅血球（megaloblast）、有絲分裂像、巨大後髓細胞與巨大帶狀核（giant metamyelocyte/band），以及核分葉過多的巨核細胞，三系皆有巨母細胞變化，符合巨母紅血球性貧血。
features: Large erythroid precursors with open, finely stippled sieve-like chromatin and basophilic to polychromatic cytoplasm (megaloblasts)
Mitotic figure in an erythroid precursor (panel A)
Giant metamyelocytes and giant band forms with large, loosely structured horseshoe-shaped nuclei (panels B-D)
Megakaryocyte with hyperlobulated, fragmented-appearing nucleus (panel C)
Hypercellular marrow fields with orthochromatic erythroblasts and a Howell-Jolly body-type inclusion (panel B)
63316.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at 100x (four panels) shows hypercellular marrow with megaloblastic change affecting multiple lineages. Erythroid precursors are enlarged with finely stippled, open chromatin and nucleocytoplasmic asynchrony, and a mitotic figure is present. Granulocytic precursors include giant metamyelocytes and giant bands with large, open horseshoe-shaped nuclei, and a megakaryocyte shows nuclear hyperlobulation. No increase in blasts is evident in these fields. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia; correlation with serum vitamin B12 and folate levels is recommended.

ddx.vs: MDS lacks vitamin deficiency and typically shows hypolobated or micromegakaryocytes and hypogranular pseudo-Pelger neutrophils rather than giant metamyelocytes.
Methotrexate, hydroxyurea, azathioprine or antiretrovirals produce identical morphology and are distinguished only by medication history and normal B12/folate.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with erythroid predominance
ddx.vs: Leukemia shows increased blasts or proerythroblasts rather than orderly maturation with giant myeloid precursors.

63252.recognize_zh: 九格組圖的周邊血抹片：低倍（A）在抹片羽狀邊緣即可見多個大細胞；高倍可見被原始細胞包圍、核圓深染的小型巨核細胞（micromegakaryocyte，B、C）、核分離成多個圓形核的發育異常巨核細胞（D–H）以及包入血球的 emperipolesis（I）；周邊血中出現巨核細胞與小型巨核細胞，提示伴巨核細胞異常的急性骨髓性白血病。
features: Panel A (low power): numerous large cells aligned along the feathered edge of the peripheral blood smear
Panels B-C: micromegakaryocytes, small cells with a single dense round nucleus and scant cytoplasm with adherent platelet blebs, admixed with blasts
Panels D, G, H: dysplastic megakaryocytes with multiple widely separated, round nuclei ('pawn ball' pattern) and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm
Panels E-F: megakaryocytes with hypolobated or clustered nuclei and cytoplasmic budding of platelets
Panel I: megakaryocyte showing emperipolesis of hematopoietic cells, with adjacent platelet clumps
Background of numerous red cells with scattered blasts; Auer rods not resolvable at this resolution
63252.describe_en: This composite of peripheral blood smear images shows circulating megakaryocytic elements in a patient with a marked blast leukocytosis. At low power (A), multiple large cells are concentrated at the feathered edge. Higher-power panels show micromegakaryocytes with a single dense round nucleus and scant cytoplasm with platelet budding admixed with blasts (B, C), dysplastic megakaryocytes with multiple separated round nuclei or hypolobated nuclei (D-H), and emperipolesis of hematopoietic cells (I). Image resolution limits evaluation of blast cytology and Auer rods. The findings are suggestive of acute myeloid leukemia with megakaryocytic dysplasia; bone marrow examination with immunophenotyping (CD41/CD61) and cytogenetics is recommended to evaluate for myelodysplasia-related changes or megakaryoblastic differentiation.

ddx.dx: Primary myelofibrosis or other MPN with circulating megakaryocytes
ddx.vs: MPNs may release megakaryocytes and nuclei into blood but show a leukoerythroblastic picture with teardrop cells and a low blast percentage, not 94% blasts.

In AMKL the blasts themselves show megakaryocytic lineage (cytoplasmic blebs, CD41/CD61+) in at least 50% of blasts, whereas here dysplastic megakaryocytes accompany a blast population that must be phenotyped.
MDS shows similar micromegakaryocytes and separated nuclei but with blasts below 20%, whereas this patient has overt leukemic blasts.

ddx.dx: Circulating tumor cells or blasts mimicking megakaryocytes
ddx.vs: Tumor cells form cohesive clusters without platelet budding, while megakaryocytes show platelet blebs, emperipolesis and CD61 positivity.

63188.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中成群出現中到大型的不成熟細胞，核呈雙葉、摺疊或啞鈴狀（bilobed/butterfly），細胞質顆粒稀少或呈細小顆粒，這是低顆粒型急性前骨髓性白血病（microgranular APL）的典型形態。
features: Clusters of medium to large immature cells, much larger than adjacent red cells
Nuclei bilobed, folded or dumbbell-shaped (butterfly) with fine to moderately condensed chromatin
Moderate cytoplasm, mostly hypogranular with fine dust-like granules; a few cells with more visible purple granulation
Cells tend to aggregate in clumps along the smear
Background red cells largely normocytic; platelets not appreciable in this field
63188.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows clusters of medium to large abnormal promyelocytes. The cells have moderate amounts of cytoplasm that is predominantly hypogranular with fine granules, and characteristic bilobed, folded or dumbbell-shaped nuclei with relatively fine chromatin. Distinct Auer rod bundles are not clearly resolved at this magnification. Platelets are not appreciable in this field. Findings are consistent with the hypogranular (microgranular) variant of acute promyelocytic leukemia, confirmed by PML::RARA fusion.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes have delicate folded nuclei with grey vacuolated cytoplasm and are nonspecific esterase positive, whereas APL cells show strong MPO positivity and PML::RARA.
Classic APL shows heavily granulated cytoplasm obscuring the nucleus and frequent faggot cells, whereas these cells are largely hypogranular.

ddx.dx: Sezary cells / T-cell lymphoma in blood
ddx.vs: Sezary cells have cerebriform convoluted nuclei with scant agranular cytoplasm and condensed chromatin, not the bilobed nuclei with granular cytoplasm seen here.
NPM1-mutated AML may share cup-like nuclear invaginations and a CD34/HLA-DR-negative phenotype, so PML::RARA testing is needed to separate it.

63124.recognize_zh: CD20 染色低倍下，強膜狀陽性的 B 細胞緊密包圍骨小樑形成袖套狀帶，間質另有散在陽性細胞，中央脂肪造血區多為陰性，呈典型骨小樑旁分布。
features: IHC for CD20 on bone marrow core biopsy, low power
Strongly membranous CD20+ cells forming cuffs around trabeculae (paratrabecular)
Scattered positive cells and small clusters in the interstitium
Intertrabecular areas with fat and hematopoiesis largely negative
Distribution less confluent than on CD19 in this field
63124.describe_en: CD20 immunostain at low power highlights B cells forming dense cuffs around bony trabeculae, with additional scattered interstitial positive cells and small clusters. The intertrabecular fat and residual hematopoietic areas are largely negative. The paratrabecular distribution of CD20-positive B cells is characteristic of follicular lymphoma involvement of the marrow, and together with the CD10, BCL2, and Ki-67 findings supports transformed follicular lymphoma.

ddx.vs: MCL may be paratrabecular but is CD5+, CD10−, and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive.
MZL tends to be intrasinusoidal or nodular interstitial and is CD10−/BCL6− without t(14;18).
Reactive aggregates are intertrabecular, well circumscribed, and composed predominantly of CD3+ T cells with fewer B cells.

63060.recognize_zh: 白箭頭是細胞質深藍、核周有淡區的早期紅系前驅細胞（前紅血球母細胞／嗜鹼性紅血球母細胞），黑箭頭則是細胞質較淡藍、無顆粒、N:C 比高且染色質細緻的母細胞；兩者需靠細胞質嗜鹼程度與染色質區分。
features: Agranular blast (black arrow): medium-sized cell, high N:C ratio, round nucleus with fine chromatin, scant pale-blue agranular cytoplasm
Early erythroid precursors (white arrows): larger round cells with intensely basophilic cytoplasm rim and slightly coarser chromatin; one with perinuclear clearing
Large cell with abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm and a single round nucleus in the center of the field (probable dysplastic mononuclear megakaryocyte)
Densely cellular particle-rich smear with many overlapping maturing myeloid and erythroid cells
Scattered fat vacuoles and red cells
63060.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is densely cellular. Scattered agranular blasts with a high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and scant, only mildly basophilic cytoplasm are present, admixed with rare early erythroid precursors that are larger and have deeply basophilic cytoplasm. A large mononuclear cell with abundant pale cytoplasm is also seen. Given the reported 18% blasts by differential, findings are consistent with a therapy-related myeloid neoplasm with increased blasts; CD34 immunostaining helps separate blasts from early erythroid precursors.

ddx.vs: Early erythroid precursors are larger with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, perinuclear halo and slightly coarser chromatin, whereas myeloblasts have paler cytoplasm and finer chromatin and are CD34+.
Hematogones are small with homogeneous condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm and show a maturing B-cell spectrum by flow, unlike larger myeloblasts.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows >80% erythroid cells with >=30% proerythroblasts, whereas here early erythroid precursors are sparse.

62996.recognize_zh: 同一視野左側是嵌在粉紅色纖維中、細胞質淡染的紡錘形肥大細胞浸潤，右側是殘存的三系造血（紅血球前驅細胞、顆粒球、巨核細胞），其中可見核葉分離的非典型巨核細胞，符合肥大細胞浸潤合併巨核細胞發育異常。
features: Sharp interface between a fibrotic spindle-cell mast cell infiltrate (left) and residual hematopoietic marrow (right)
Mast cells with oval to elongated nuclei and pale, clear to lightly eosinophilic cytoplasm within thick pink collagen
Residual trilineage hematopoiesis with erythroid precursors, maturing granulocytes and eosinophils
Megakaryocytes including an atypical form with separated nuclear lobes
Interspersed extravasated red cells in the hematopoietic area
62996.describe_en: H&E section shows an atypical mast cell infiltrate composed of spindled to oval cells with pale cytoplasm embedded in thick eosinophilic collagen, sharply juxtaposed to residual trilineage hematopoiesis. The hematopoietic area contains erythroid precursors, maturing granulocytes, eosinophils and megakaryocytes, including an atypical megakaryocyte with widely separated nuclear lobes. Findings are consistent with systemic mastocytosis with associated fibrosis and dysmegakaryopoiesis; assessment for an associated myeloid neoplasm (SM-AHN) with KIT D816V and myeloid NGS is warranted.

ddx.dx: Systemic mastocytosis with an associated hematologic neoplasm
ddx.vs: SM-AHN requires a separately diagnosable myeloid neoplasm (e.g. MDS, CMML) in the non-mast-cell compartment, established by counts, dysplasia quantification and genetics.
MDS-F shows dysplastic megakaryocytes and fibrosis without tryptase+/CD25+ spindled mast cell aggregates.
PMF megakaryocytes are clustered with hyperchromatic, cloud-like nuclei, and the fibrotic areas lack CD117+ mast cells.

62932.recognize_zh: 室溫下的周邊血液抹片，低倍即可見多個由嗜中性球緊密聚在一起的花團狀團塊，高倍確認團塊內是分葉核、細胞質帶顆粒的成熟嗜中性球；這種白血球成團是嗜中性球凝集（neutrophil agglutination）造成假性白血球減少的線索。
features: Multiple tight rosette-like aggregates of mature neutrophils scattered across the smear at low power
High power: aggregates contain 5 to 30 segmented neutrophils with fine cytoplasmic granules
Neutrophil nuclei within clumps are intact without phagocytic inclusions or degenerative change
Single lymphocytes remain unclumped; scattered platelets present
Red cells show overlapping/chain-like arrangement in a thick area
62932.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear from an EDTA sample kept at room temperature shows numerous discrete clumps of leukocytes at low power. At high power the aggregates are composed of mature segmented neutrophils with normal granulation, while lymphocytes are dispersed singly; no platelet aggregates are part of the clumps. No blasts or tumor cell clusters are identified. Findings are consistent with in vitro neutrophil agglutination, a cause of spurious leukopenia and analyzer differential failure that resolves with warming of the specimen.

ddx.vs: The aggregates consist of platelets rather than segmented neutrophils.
Platelets adhere in a ring around individual neutrophils, whereas here neutrophils adhere to one another.
Tumor clusters contain large cells with non-segmented atypical nuclei and cohesive cytoplasm, not mature granulated neutrophils.

ddx.dx: Leukocyte carryover at the smear feathered edge
ddx.vs: Edge artifact concentrates cells at the tail but does not form discrete tight clumps throughout the monolayer and resolves with a better-made smear, not warming.

62868.recognize_zh: 這是 PCR 產物的凝膠電泳圖：TCR beta 與 TCR gamma 的樣本道出現紅框標示的清楚分立條帶（單株性），而 IGH 各道只見多株性模糊條帶，支持病灶為單株性 T 細胞增生。
features: Agarose/polyacrylamide gel images of PCR products with molecular weight markers on each side
TCR beta panel: discrete bands in patient lanes (boxed in red) against polyclonal controls, labeled positive
TCR gamma panel: discrete doublet band in patient lane (boxed), labeled positive
IGH panel: no discrete dominant band in patient lanes, labeled negative
Positive controls (PA, PB, PC) and no-template controls (NA, NB, NC) included
62868.describe_en: The figure shows gel electrophoresis of PCR-based clonality assays. Patient lanes for TCR beta and TCR gamma gene rearrangement show discrete, sharp bands of defined size (boxed), indicating a clonal T-cell population, whereas the IGH assay shows no dominant clonal band. Appropriate positive and no-template controls and size ladders are present. Clonal TCR rearrangement with polyclonal IGH supports a clonal T-cell process, consistent with indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder in the appropriate morphologic and immunophenotypic context; clonality alone does not establish malignancy.

ddx.vs: Pseudoclonal peaks are small, not reproducible in duplicate runs and occur with scant T-cell input, whereas true clonal bands are reproducible across targets.
A B-cell neoplasm would show a clonal IGH band, which is absent here.

62740.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見大型組織球，胞質含多個空泡，並吞入紅血球、有核紅血球或淋巴球等完整細胞（A、B），即噬血現象（hemophagocytosis），配合臨床用藥史支持 lamotrigine 相關的 HLH。
features: Large macrophages with abundant pale, vacuolated cytoplasm
Engulfed intact nucleated cells (erythroid precursors/lymphocytes) and red cell fragments within macrophage cytoplasm (A, B)
Macrophage nucleus displaced to the periphery by phagocytosed material
Background of mature-appearing erythroid precursors and lymphocytes without an obvious blast population in these fields
62740.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered large macrophages with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing engulfed intact nucleated hematopoietic cells, including erythroid precursors and lymphocytes, as well as red cell debris. The background hematopoietic cells appear mature without a conspicuous blast population in the illustrated fields. Hemophagocytosis is supportive but not diagnostic on its own; in the appropriate clinical and laboratory context (HLH-2004 criteria, recent lamotrigine exposure) the findings are consistent with drug-associated secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, so distinction rests on HLH-2004 clinical criteria such as fever, splenomegaly, ferritin, triglycerides, fibrinogen and soluble CD25.
Also drug-induced and overlaps with HLH, but is defined by rash, eosinophilia and atypical lymphocytes rather than marrow hemophagocytosis with cytopenias and hyperferritinemia.
Requires search for an atypical lymphoid infiltrate by biopsy, flow cytometry or clonality studies, which is not evident in these aspirate fields.
Phagocytosis is performed by high N:C ratio monocytic blasts rather than by mature histiocytes.

62676.recognize_zh: 中倍 CD10 染色可見結節區內大片細胞膜強陽性的細胞，結節外的濾泡間區也有許多 CD10 陽性細胞散布；濾泡外出現 CD10 陽性 B 細胞支持濾泡性淋巴瘤的濾泡間浸潤。
features: Intermediate power: dense nodular areas with strong membranous CD10 staining (upper left, lower center)
Numerous CD10-positive cells extend into interfollicular zones
CD10-negative small lymphocytes form pale islands between positive cells
Vessels and endothelium negative
Membranous, crisp staining pattern
62676.describe_en: CD10 immunohistochemistry at intermediate power shows dense nodules of cells with strong membranous CD10 expression, with many additional CD10-positive cells infiltrating the interfollicular zones among CD10-negative small lymphocytes. CD10-positive B cells outside follicles are not seen in reactive nodes and indicate interfollicular spread of germinal center-derived neoplastic cells. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma with interfollicular involvement.

ddx.vs: In reactive nodes CD10 is confined to germinal centers, without interfollicular CD10-positive B cells.

ddx.dx: Nodal T-follicular helper cell lymphoma (angioimmunoblastic type)
ddx.vs: Neoplastic TFH cells may be CD10 positive but are CD3/PD1 positive T cells with clear cytoplasm around HEVs, requiring correlation with CD20.
These show diffuse sheets of CD10-positive large or medium cells rather than a nodular pattern with interfollicular spread of small cells.

62612.recognize_zh: 觸摸抹片中為鬆散分布的中型細胞，核圓且偏位、染色質細顆粒、細胞質嗜鹼性藍色並有核旁淡染區，呈漿細胞樣／漿母細胞樣外觀。
features: Discohesive population of intermediate-sized cells
Round, often eccentric nuclei with finely granular to slightly coarse chromatin; inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm, some with paranuclear pale zone (hof)
Many stripped/naked nuclei and cytoplasmic fragments in a bubbly proteinaceous background
Scattered small lymphocytes and degenerated red cells
62612.describe_en: Touch imprint (Romanowsky-type stain) shows a discohesive population of intermediate-sized plasmacytoid cells with round eccentric nuclei, finely granular chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, some with a perinuclear clearing. Numerous bare nuclei and cytoplasmic fragments are present owing to fragility of the cells, with a few small lymphocytes in the background. The cytology indicates a monomorphic plasmacytoid neoplasm and, with tissue immunostains, is consistent with EBV-positive plasmacytoma-like PTLD.

ddx.vs: Plasmablasts are larger with more open chromatin and single prominent central nucleoli, while these cells retain plasmacytoid features with small nucleoli.
DLBCL cells lack eccentric nuclei with hofs and show CD20 positivity on tissue sections.
Reactive infiltrates are mixed with many small lymphocytes, neutrophils and histiocytes rather than a monotonous plasmacytoid population.

62548.recognize_zh: 上下兩個間期核分別使用 MYC 與 BCL2 雙色斷裂分離（break-apart）探針：各有一組紅綠融合訊號（正常等位基因）加上一個分開的紅點與綠點（斷裂），代表 MYC 與 BCL2 同時重排，即雙打擊淋巴瘤。
features: Interphase FISH with MYC dual-color break-apart probe (5' MYC red, 3' MYC green)
MYC nucleus: one fused red-green signal plus one separate red and one separate green signal, indicating MYC rearrangement
Interphase FISH with BCL2 dual-color break-apart probe (5' BCL2 red, 3' BCL2 green)
BCL2 nucleus: one fused signal plus split red and green signals, indicating BCL2 rearrangement
62548.describe_en: Interphase fluorescence in situ hybridization was performed with dual-color break-apart probes for MYC (5' red, 3' green) and BCL2 (5' red, 3' green). In each representative nucleus, one allele shows a fused or closely apposed red-green signal (intact locus), while the other allele shows widely separated red and green signals, indicating a break within the locus. These results demonstrate concurrent rearrangements of MYC and BCL2. Break-apart probes do not identify the partner gene. In a large B-cell lymphoma, this is consistent with high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements (double-hit).

62484.recognize_zh: 脾臟 H&E 高倍下，右上方為成片的小到中型淋巴球，核圓或略不規則，部分有少量淡色細胞質；左下方紅血球間的紅髓脾索與竇內也被同樣的淋巴球浸潤，符合脾邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: Dense infiltrate of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Some cells with a modest rim of pale cytoplasm (marginal zone-like)
Sheet-like nodular area (upper right) merging with red pulp infiltration among erythrocytes (lower left)
No large-cell sheets, starry-sky pattern, or prominent mitoses in this field
62484.describe_en: Section of spleen shows a dense, monotonous infiltrate of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells forming a sheet in the white pulp region and extending into the adjacent red pulp, where the cells percolate between congested erythrocytes in cords and sinusoids. The cells have round to slightly irregular nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and a modest rim of pale cytoplasm. Large transformed cells are not increased in this field. Findings are consistent with involvement by a low-grade B-cell lymphoma, compatible with splenic marginal zone lymphoma in conjunction with the CD20-positive, CD43-negative immunophenotype.

ddx.vs: MCL cells have more irregular, cleaved nuclei with scant cytoplasm and are cyclin D1/SOX11 positive, which requires immunostaining to exclude.
CLL/SLL shows smaller round cells with scant cytoplasm, proliferation centers with prolymphocytes, and CD5/CD23/LEF1 co-expression.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL diffusely fills red pulp with atrophic rather than expanded white pulp and has villous cells with more basophilic cytoplasm.
LPL shows plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with Dutcher bodies and MYD88 L265P in most cases.

62420.recognize_zh: 黑箭頭所指的巨核細胞有多個彼此分離、圓形的小核（separated nuclei），不同於正常巨核細胞的連續分葉核；紅箭頭指出的紅血球前驅細胞呈核出芽、多葉核與不規則核型——骨髓中同時出現巨核細胞與紅血球系發育不良，即多系發育不良。
features: Megakaryocyte with multiple widely separated, round nuclei (black arrow) instead of a single lobulated nucleus
Erythroid precursors with irregular nuclear contours, nuclear budding and multilobation (red arrows)
Small dense erythroid nuclei with budding/karyorrhectic fragments
Cellular aspirate with abundant erythroid and granulocytic precursors around a spicule
Some granulocytic precursors appear normally granulated in this field
62420.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle with abundant erythroid and granulocytic precursors. A megakaryocyte with multiple widely separated round nuclei is present (black arrow). Several erythroid precursors show dyserythropoietic changes including irregular nuclear contours, nuclear budding and multilobation (red arrows). Granulocytic precursors in this field show no obvious dysplasia, although full assessment requires a 500-cell differential. Findings are consistent with multilineage dysplasia (megakaryocytic and erythroid), as seen in myelodysplastic neoplasm; in combination with ring sideroblasts on iron stain, this supports MDS with ring sideroblasts/SF3B1 mutation.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic change shows nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with open sieve-like chromatin and giant metamyelocytes, and resolves with vitamin replacement.

ddx.dx: Reactive/toxic dyserythropoiesis (alcohol, drugs, HIV, copper deficiency)
ddx.vs: Secondary causes can produce identical erythroid dysplasia, so clinical history, copper levels and absence of clonal abnormality are required to exclude them.
CDA shows striking binucleated/multinucleated erythroblasts with isolated erythroid involvement and normal megakaryocytes in a young patient.
A normal megakaryocyte has lobes connected by chromatin bridges, whereas truly separated round nuclei are a dysplastic feature.

62356.recognize_zh: 瀰漫性腫瘤細胞呈強而廣泛的膜狀與顆粒狀胞質 CD10 棕色染色；雖然 CD10 常被視為 B 細胞或生發中心標記，T 淋巴母細胞淋巴瘤也常見陽性，不應因此誤判為 B 系。
features: Diffuse strong CD10 staining throughout the tumor sheet
Membranous and granular cytoplasmic staining pattern
Tumor cells medium-sized with scant cytoplasm and pale oval nuclei
Scattered unstained spaces and stromal/vascular elements
62356.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD10 shows strong, diffuse membranous and granular cytoplasmic staining in the majority of tumor cells, with negative stromal and vascular elements. CD10 is expressed in a substantial proportion of T-lymphoblastic lymphomas and does not by itself indicate B lineage. In conjunction with CD3 and TdT positivity and absent B-cell markers, findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: B-LBL is CD10+ TdT+ but also CD19+, CD79a+ and PAX5+ and lacks CD3.
Burkitt is CD10+ but CD20+, TdT-negative, with a starry-sky pattern and MYC rearrangement.
AITL has CD10+ T follicular helper cells but they are mature, TdT-negative, and accompanied by FDC meshworks and arborizing vessels.

62292.recognize_zh: 四張免疫染色中，CD2、CD3、CD7（A–C）在擴大的副皮質區呈瀰漫強陽性，濾泡處為陰性淡區；D 圖 CD5 只有部分細胞強陽性、其餘多數細胞陰性，提示腫瘤性 T 細胞 CD5 表現缺失，支持 T 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Panel A (CD2): diffuse strong staining of the expanded paracortex with negative residual follicles
Panel B (CD3): diffuse positivity across the node sparing scattered pale follicles
Panel C (CD7): diffuse positivity of the interfollicular infiltrate
Panel D (CD5): only a subset of lymphocytes strongly positive, with many intervening negative medium-sized cells, suggesting partial CD5 loss
Architecture effaced by a T-cell-rich infiltrate with residual B-cell follicles appearing as negative nodules
62292.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stains on the lymph node show a diffuse T-cell infiltrate expanding the paracortex. CD2, CD3 and CD7 stain the infiltrate diffusely and strongly, with residual follicles appearing as negative pale nodules at low power. CD5 at higher power highlights only a subset of lymphocytes, while many of the medium-sized atypical cells are negative, indicating partial loss of CD5 expression by the neoplastic population. This aberrant T-cell immunophenotype supports a T-cell lymphoma and, with EBER positivity in the majority of T cells, is consistent with systemic EBV-positive T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive T-zone expansions retain uniform expression of all pan-T-cell antigens including CD5 and CD7, without antigen loss.
NK/T-cell lymphoma is surface CD3-negative (cytoplasmic CD3epsilon+), CD5-negative, CD56-positive, with angiocentric necrosis and usually extranodal presentation.
AITL neoplastic cells often show CD7 loss with TFH marker expression (PD-1, CXCL13, ICOS) and expanded FDC meshworks.
ATLL is CD4+ CD25+ with CD7 loss and HTLV-1 serology, rather than EBV-positive CD8+ cells.

62164.recognize_zh: 未染色的血型鑑定鏡檢中，散在大小不一的紅血球凝集塊，周圍卻有大量未凝集的游離紅血球，這種「凝集團塊與游離細胞並存」即混合視野（mixed field）；此例為 A 型病人輸入 O 型紅血球後，抗 A 試劑只凝集病人自身細胞。
features: Unstained low-power microscopic view of red cells after reaction with typing reagent
Multiple small to medium agglutinates (clumps) of red cells
Large number of free, unagglutinated red cells between the clumps
Some free red cells appear crenated
No stacked coin-like (rouleaux) arrays
62164.describe_en: Unstained microscopic preparation of red cells after incubation with anti-A typing reagent shows scattered agglutinates of variable size interspersed among numerous free, unagglutinated red cells. No rouleaux formation is seen. The coexistence of agglutinated and unagglutinated cell populations defines a mixed-field reaction. In a group A patient recently transfused with group O red cells, the agglutinates represent the patient's own A cells and the free cells represent transfused O cells, consistent with mixed field due to transfusion of group O red cells.

ddx.vs: A3 red cells characteristically give a mixed-field pattern with anti-A without any transfusion history, and are identified by secretor/adsorption-elution studies.
ABO-mismatched transplant recipients show mixed field from coexisting donor and recipient red cells, identified by transplant history and chimerism studies.
Rouleaux form stacked coin-like chains that disperse with saline replacement, whereas true agglutinates are irregular clumps that persist.
Mixed field from fetal cells in maternal blood is seen postpartum and is quantified by Kleihauer-Betke or flow cytometry for HbF.

62036.recognize_zh: 高倍下可見大型異型細胞連續成片（confluent sheets）取代淋巴組織，核大呈泡狀、核仁明顯、細胞質豐富嗜酸性，並有核分裂與凋亡小體，小淋巴球僅零星夾雜，符合 NLPHL 進展為瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Confluent sheets of large atypical cells replacing the lymphoid background
Large vesicular nuclei with irregular contours, some multilobated, and prominent eosinophilic nucleoli
Moderate to abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies scattered throughout
Only scattered interspersed small lymphocytes; delicate fibrillary stroma
62036.describe_en: High-power H&E section shows confluent sheets of large atypical cells with large vesicular, irregular to multilobated nuclei, prominent eosinophilic nucleoli, and moderate to abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm. Mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies are readily identified, and small lymphocytes are reduced to scattered interspersed cells. The large cells no longer occur singly within a lymphocyte-rich background but form sheets. In the setting of nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma, findings are consistent with progression to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma; CD20, PAX5, OCT2, CD30, CD15 and EBER should confirm the B-cell phenotype and exclude other large-cell neoplasms.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma, lymphocyte-depleted / syncytial variant
ddx.vs: Syncytial sheets of HRS cells are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5 and absent OCT2/BOB1, unlike the strong B-cell program of LP-derived DLBCL.
ALCL shows hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei and uniform strong CD30 with T-cell or ALK expression, rather than CD20+ large B cells.
Carcinoma and melanoma form cohesive nests with keratin or S100/SOX10 positivity and are CD45 negative.

ddx.dx: Primary mediastinal or de novo DLBCL
ddx.vs: Morphology is indistinguishable, so the relationship to NLPHL is established by residual NLPHL areas and clinical history.

61972.recognize_zh: CD5 免疫染色中，真皮內小到中型淋巴球絕大多數呈強且清楚的細胞膜陽性，只剩少數藍色陰性細胞群（多為 B 細胞區）；CD5 保留表現是 CD4+ 小/中型 T 細胞增生性疾病常見的表型，與常有泛 T 標記缺失的侵襲性 T 細胞淋巴瘤不同。
features: Dense infiltrate of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells
Strong, crisp membranous CD5 staining in the majority of cells
Intervening pockets of CD5-negative cells, likely B cells and histiocytes
Positive cells show slight variation in size, including some medium-sized cells
No evidence of loss of CD5 in the dominant population
61972.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD5 on a skin biopsy shows a dense lymphoid infiltrate in which the majority of small to medium-sized cells show strong membranous staining, with interspersed pockets of CD5-negative cells. There is no apparent loss of CD5 in the dominant T-cell population. Retention of CD5 and other pan-T antigens with only variable CD7 loss is typical of primary cutaneous CD4-positive small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder. Findings are consistent with a CD5-positive T-cell-rich infiltrate in this context.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: Aggressive cutaneous PTCL typically has larger, more pleomorphic cells exceeding 30%, ulceration and frequent loss of multiple pan-T antigens, rather than retained CD5.
CLL cells are CD5-positive B cells that coexpress CD20, CD23 and LEF1, whereas this CD5-positive population is CD3-positive T cells.
Mycosis fungoides can retain CD5 but is defined by epidermotropic CD4+ T cells in a patch/plaque clinical setting.

61908.recognize_zh: 高倍下深層真皮至皮下脂肪交界處有密集的小至中型淋巴樣細胞，核形不規則、有些拉長或有凹痕、染色質深，並散在少數較大細胞，浸潤延伸到右上方的脂肪組織；這種輕中度異型的深層浸潤符合HV-LPD的細胞學表現。
features: Dense infiltrate of small to medium lymphoid cells with irregular, indented or elongated hyperchromatic nuclei
Scattered larger cells with vesicular chromatin and occasional nucleoli
Infiltrate extends from deep dermis into adjacent subcutaneous fat (upper right)
Perivascular accentuation around a small vessel at upper center
Admixed stromal spindle cells; no necrosis or eosinophil-rich background
61908.describe_en: Sections of deep dermis and subcutis show a dense infiltrate of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with irregular, indented hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm, admixed with scattered larger cells with vesicular chromatin. The infiltrate shows perivascular accentuation and extends into subcutaneous fat. Necrosis is not seen in this field. These cytologic features indicate a mildly to moderately atypical lymphoid infiltrate; with an EBER-positive cytotoxic T/NK phenotype and the clinical picture of photodistributed vesiculopapular lesions, they are consistent with hydroa vacciniforme lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: SPTCL is confined to the subcutis with adipocyte rimming by CD8+ beta-F1+ cells and is EBER-negative, whereas this infiltrate involves deep dermis as well.
ENKTL shows more pleomorphic cells, angiodestruction and zonal necrosis with EBER positivity in an older, non-photodistributed setting.
Gamma-delta TCL is EBER-negative, TCR-gamma-positive/beta-F1-negative and usually shows epidermal and subcutaneous necrosis.

61844.recognize_zh: 纖維化的真皮中散布泡沫狀組織球，中央可見一顆核呈環狀排列、中心為嗜伊紅細胞質、外圍泡沫狀的 Touton 巨細胞；泡沫組織球加 Touton 巨細胞是 Erdheim-Chester 病的重要線索。
features: Infiltrate of histiocytes with pale foamy to granular cytoplasm and bland oval nuclei
Touton-type multinucleated giant cell with a wreath of nuclei around central eosinophilic cytoplasm
Additional multinucleated giant cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm
Background storiform dermal fibrosis and thick collagen bundles
Scattered small lymphocytes; no significant nuclear atypia or mitoses
61844.describe_en: Section of dermis shows a diffuse infiltrate of histiocytes with pale foamy to eosinophilic cytoplasm and bland oval nuclei, set in a fibrotic stroma with thickened collagen bundles. A Touton-type giant cell with a ring of nuclei surrounding central eosinophilic cytoplasm is present, along with other multinucleated histiocytic giant cells and scattered lymphocytes. No significant cytologic atypia or mitotic activity is seen. Findings are consistent with a xanthogranulomatous histiocytic infiltrate compatible with Erdheim-Chester disease in the appropriate clinical and radiologic setting.

ddx.vs: JXG has identical Touton giant cells and phenotype, so separation relies on age, lesion distribution, and systemic features such as bilateral long-bone osteosclerosis.
LCH lacks foamy Touton giant cells and instead has grooved Langerhans cells with eosinophils and CD1a/Langerin expression.
NXG shows broad zones of necrobiotic collagen with cholesterol clefts and bizarre giant cells, associated with monoclonal gammopathy.
Dermatofibroma is a localized lesion with epidermal hyperplasia and collagen trapping at the periphery, without systemic disease or BRAF V600E.

61716.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片高倍只見一個單核細胞：大小略大於紅血球，核稍不規則、染色質中度濃縮，胞質淡染並帶細小顆粒／微空泡；單看這一顆細胞並不具特異性，需配合流式與免疫染色才能判定為 BPDCN 循環腫瘤細胞。
features: Single small-to-intermediate mononuclear cell, about 1.5 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Slightly irregular, indented nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin; no distinct nucleolus
Moderate rim of pale cytoplasm with fine granular/microvacuolated texture
No Auer rods or coarse granules
Background red cells normocytic without other diagnostic abnormalities
61716.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows a single small-to-intermediate mononuclear cell with a slightly irregular nucleus, moderately condensed chromatin without a conspicuous nucleolus, and a moderate rim of pale cytoplasm with fine granular or microvacuolated texture. Background red cells are unremarkable. The morphology of this isolated cell is nonspecific and could represent a circulating neoplastic cell, a large granular lymphocyte or a reactive lymphocyte. In the context of known blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm it may represent a circulating tumor cell, but confirmation requires flow cytometry (CD4, CD56, CD123-bright, HLA-DR).

ddx.vs: LGLs have discrete coarse azurophilic granules in more abundant clear cytoplasm and a round mature nucleus, and are CD3/CD8 or CD56/CD16-positive without CD123.
Reactive lymphocytes typically have more abundant basophilic cytoplasm that scallops around red cells, rather than a fine microvacuolated rim.
Monocytes are larger with folded nuclei, lacy chromatin and gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and vacuoles, and are CD14+/CD64+ on flow.

61652.recognize_zh: 周邊血中一個異常前骨髓細胞，核型不規則（摺疊、似雙葉），胞質邊緣呈藍色並充滿粗大紫紅色顆粒而遮蓋核，是 APL 在血中出現異常前骨髓細胞的線索。
features: Single abnormal promyelocyte with irregular, folded to bilobed nucleus
Cytoplasm filled with coarse purple-red azurophilic granules overlying the nucleus
Pale-blue agranular cytoplasmic rim at one pole
No mature neutrophils in the field; platelets not evident
Background normochromic red cells with rouleaux-like overlap in thicker area
61652.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an abnormal promyelocyte with an irregular, folded nucleus partially obscured by coarse azurophilic cytoplasmic granules and a pale-blue agranular rim. No Auer rods are clearly resolved in this cell. Platelets and mature neutrophils are not evident in this field. Findings are suggestive of circulating abnormal promyelocytes of acute promyelocytic leukemia; coagulation studies and urgent PML::RARA testing are indicated.

ddx.vs: Normal promyelocytes have round nuclei with a Golgi hof and are accompanied by myelocytes and neutrophilia rather than cytopenia.
The microgranular variant has bilobed nuclei with few or dust-like granules and a high white count, not coarse obscuring granules.
Monocytic cells have gray-blue cytoplasm with fine dust-like granules and vacuoles, and delicate lacy chromatin.

61588.recognize_zh: 肝臟竇狀隙內的浸潤細胞大多 CD34 陰性，只見零星幾顆 CD34 陽性的母細胞，右下血管內皮為內部陽性對照；說明 JMML 浸潤以成熟中的骨髓單核系細胞為主、母細胞並未增加到急性白血病程度。
features: Liver parenchyma with hepatocyte plates and infiltrated sinusoids
Only rare scattered CD34-positive mononuclear cells (strong cytoplasmic/membranous staining)
Majority of infiltrating sinusoidal cells are CD34-negative
CD34-positive endothelium of a vessel at lower right (internal positive control)
No clusters or sheets of CD34-positive blasts
61588.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD34 on a liver section shows hepatocyte plates with sinusoids containing an infiltrate of hematopoietic cells. Only rare scattered infiltrating cells are CD34-positive, and the vast majority of sinusoidal cells are negative; endothelium of a vessel serves as an internal positive control. There are no clusters or sheets of CD34-positive blasts. Findings indicate that blasts are not increased within the hepatic infiltrate, supporting involvement by juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia rather than transformation to acute leukemia.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia / myeloid sarcoma involving liver
ddx.vs: Would show numerous or sheet-like CD34+ (or CD117+) blasts, whereas CD34+ cells here are rare.
Also has few CD34+ cells; distinguished by megakaryocytes/erythroid islands without monocytic predominance and by clinical setting.
Shows many circulating/hepatic megakaryoblasts that are often CD34+/CD41+/CD61+, with GATA1 mutation.

61524.recognize_zh: 高倍下小淋巴球背景中散布大量 lacunar 細胞：大型細胞核呈多葉狀、核仁小，周圍淡染胞質收縮形成清楚透明空隙，部分成群聚集，搭配纖細膠原纖維，符合結節硬化型 CHL。
features: Numerous lacunar cells with large lobated nuclei and small nucleoli within clear, retracted cytoplasmic spaces
Lacunar cells focally clustered in small aggregates, especially in the right half of the field
Background of small round lymphocytes and occasional histiocytes
Fine collagen strands and small vessels between cell groups
No necrosis or sheets of confluent large cells in this field
61524.describe_en: High-power view of a lymph node shows a background of small lymphocytes with numerous scattered and focally clustered lacunar cells. These large cells have multilobated nuclei with small nucleoli and pale cytoplasm retracted to create empty lacunar spaces. Fine collagen strands and small vessels traverse the infiltrate, and there is no necrosis or confluent sheet of large cells in this field. Findings are consistent with classic Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis subtype.

ddx.dx: Syncytial variant of nodular sclerosis CHL
ddx.vs: The syncytial variant has cohesive sheets of lacunar cells often with central necrosis, whereas here lacunar cells are scattered or in small clusters.
PMBL clear cells form continuous sheets of uniformly strong CD20+ large cells rather than scattered lacunar cells among small lymphocytes.
Histiocytes have bland oval to reniform nuclei without prominent lobation or nucleoli and are CD68/CD163-positive and CD30-negative.

61460.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中幾乎全為成片的漿細胞：核偏位、胞質豐富嗜雙性、核旁淡染區（hof），許多細胞核較大並有明顯核仁，正常造血細胞幾乎被取代，符合多發性骨髓瘤。
features: Sheets of plasma cells effacing the marrow with virtually no residual normal hematopoiesis
Moderate to abundant amphophilic cytoplasm with eccentric nuclei and perinuclear clearing (hof)
Many cells with enlarged nuclei, vesicular chromatin, and prominent central nucleoli (atypical/immature plasma cells)
Occasional binucleate plasma cells and variation in nuclear size
Scattered red cells in capillaries; no fat or megakaryocytes in this field
61460.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a packed, diffuse infiltrate of plasma cells replacing normal hematopoietic elements. The plasma cells have eccentric nuclei, amphophilic cytoplasm, and perinuclear hofs; many show nuclear enlargement, vesicular chromatin, and prominent nucleoli, with occasional binucleation. Normal trilineage hematopoiesis is not identified in this field. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with diffuse marrow replacement; CD138 immunostaining and kappa/lambda ISH are recommended to quantify plasma cells and confirm light-chain restriction.

ddx.vs: LPL shows a mixture of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with CD20+ B cells and MYD88 L265P, not pure sheets of atypical plasma cells.
Cells are larger blastic with high mitotic/apoptotic rate, often EBER+ in immunocompromised patients, and lack a myeloma M-protein/lytic lesion profile.
Reactive plasma cells are interstitial and perivascular, polytypic by kappa/lambda, and do not form sheets.
Carcinoma cells are cohesive with keratin positivity and lack the plasma cell hof and CD138+/light-chain restricted profile.

61396.recognize_zh: CD30 免疫染色中，數顆大型多葉核細胞呈強陽性的細胞膜與核旁高基氏體（Golgi）點狀染色，周圍中型免疫母細胞呈中等強度陽性，小淋巴球背景為陰性；這種 Hodgkin 樣大細胞 CD30 陽性是 EBV 陽性黏膜皮膚潰瘍的典型表現。
features: Large cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD30 staining outlining large vesicular, lobated nuclei
Paranuclear Golgi-type dot accentuation in several positive cells
Intermediate-sized immunoblast-like cells with moderate, granular CD30 staining
Small background lymphocytes and stromal cells negative
Positive cells scattered singly and in small loose clusters, without sheet-like growth
61396.describe_en: CD30 immunohistochemistry shows strong membranous and paranuclear Golgi-pattern staining in the large Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg-like cells, which have large lobated vesicular nuclei. Intermediate-sized immunoblasts show moderate, more granular staining, while the small background lymphocytes and stromal cells are negative. The positive cells are scattered singly and in loose clusters rather than forming sheets. Findings support activated large B cells/HRS-like cells and, together with B-cell marker expression and EBER positivity, are consistent with EBV-positive mucocutaneous ulcer.

ddx.vs: HRS cells show the same membranous/Golgi CD30 pattern, so distinction requires CD15 positivity, CD20 negativity and weak PAX5, plus a nodal presentation.
CD30 is uniformly strong in cohesive sheets of hallmark cells with T-cell or null phenotype and PAX5 negativity.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous CD30+ lymphoproliferative disorder (lymphomatoid papulosis)
ddx.vs: CD30+ large cells are T cells (CD4+, PAX5-negative) and are typically EBER-negative.

61204.recognize_zh: 影像中央有一顆與周圍紅血球差不多大、含粗大紫紅色顆粒的圓形巨大血小板（giant platelet），旁邊的正常血小板則小得多，符合 Bernard-Soulier 症候群的巨大血小板。
features: Giant platelet approximately the size of adjacent red cells, round, with abundant coarse purple granules (granulomere) and a pale peripheral hyalomere
Occasional normal-sized small platelets for comparison
Normocytic, normochromic red cells with central pallor
A granulocyte with a band-like nucleus and one red cell with a dark overlying inclusion/debris are present
No platelet clumps seen in this field
61204.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells and a granulocyte. A giant platelet, comparable in diameter to the surrounding red cells, is present with abundant coarse granules; the few other platelets are of normal size. No platelet clumping is evident in this field. In the setting of thrombocytopenia and a prolonged bleeding time, findings are consistent with a macrothrombocytopenia such as Bernard-Soulier syndrome; confirmation requires ristocetin aggregation studies and flow cytometry for CD42b/GPIb-IX.

ddx.vs: MYH9 disorders show giant platelets together with Dohle-like basophilic inclusions in neutrophils, and ristocetin-induced aggregation is normal.
ITP shows only mildly enlarged young platelets rather than numerous red-cell-sized platelets, and GPIb-IX expression is normal on flow cytometry.
Gray platelets are large but pale and agranular, lacking alpha granules, unlike these densely granular giant platelets.
EDTA-induced clumps form aggregates of normal-sized platelets, whereas here individual platelets are enlarged.

61140.recognize_zh: 抹片中大型細胞具深藍色細胞質與核旁淡染區（hof），乍看像漿細胞；但細胞質深嗜鹼性、核圓且染色質較細，PAS 呈粗顆粒／塊狀陽性，流式為 CD71、CD36 強陽性，指向原始紅血球（pronormoblast）而非漿細胞。
features: Aspirate (A): large cells with round central to eccentric nuclei, fine to moderately condensed chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a distinct perinuclear hof (plasmacytoid appearance, inset)
Occasional cytoplasmic vacuoles and cytoplasmic blebs; admixed later erythroid precursors
Biopsy (B): diffuse sheets of large immature cells with round nuclei, vesicular chromatin and visible nucleoli, replacing normal marrow
PAS (G): coarse granular to block-like cytoplasmic positivity in the large cells
Flow cytometry (C-F): abnormal population with dim/negative CD45 and strong CD71 with CD36 co-expression
IHC (H): diffuse strong staining of the infiltrate (marker not labeled; erythroid marker expected)
61140.describe_en: Composite figure. The bone marrow aspirate shows numerous large immature cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a prominent perinuclear hof that imparts a plasmacytoid appearance, together with occasional vacuoles. The core biopsy is effaced by sheets of large cells with round nuclei and nucleoli. Flow cytometry identifies a CD45-dim/negative population with bright CD71 and CD36 expression, PAS shows coarse granular to block cytoplasmic positivity, and an immunostain labels the sheets diffusely. Despite the hof, the lineage evidence favors pronormoblasts over plasma cells, and the findings are consistent with pure erythroid leukemia mimicking plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Myeloma cells have clockface chromatin and a hof but are CD138/CD38 bright with light-chain restriction and lack CD71/CD36/E-cadherin erythroid expression and PAS block positivity.
Megakaryoblasts show cytoplasmic blebs too but express CD41/CD61 rather than bright CD71 with glycophorin/E-cadherin.
B12/folate deficiency shows full maturation with megaloblastic changes and hypersegmented neutrophils, not sheets of pronormoblasts with arrested maturation.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Metastatic tumor forms cohesive clusters and is keratin, synaptophysin or CD99 positive, lacking erythroid markers.

61140.stain: Wright-Giemsa, H&E, PAS, IHC, flow cytometry

61076.recognize_zh: 臨床照片顯示雙側眼瞼腫脹、黃褐色結痂與瘀青樣變色的眼周浸潤；抹片中為大型芽細胞，核圓形、染色質細緻、有明顯核仁及中等量淡藍色細胞質（單核芽細胞，monoblast），治療後照片浸潤消退。
features: Clinical photos (A, B): bilateral periorbital swelling with violaceous-brown discoloration and yellow crusting of eyelid margins
Smear (C): large blasts with round to oval nuclei, fine lacy chromatin, one or more prominent nucleoli, and moderate to abundant pale blue agranular cytoplasm (monoblasts)
Cytologic preparation (D): cohesive-appearing cluster of monomorphic blasts with round nuclei, likely from a tissue imprint/aspirate of the infiltrate
Clinical photos (E, F): resolution of periorbital and periauricular infiltration after treatment
61076.describe_en: Clinical photographs show bilateral periorbital swelling with discoloration and crusting, with later images demonstrating resolution after therapy. The smear shows a population of large blasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin, prominent nucleoli and moderate to abundant pale blue cytoplasm without Auer rods, consistent with monoblasts; a second cytologic preparation shows sheets of similar monomorphic blasts. Findings are consistent with acute monoblastic leukemia with extramedullary (periorbital/periauricular soft tissue) infiltration; nonspecific esterase positivity and a monocytic immunophenotype (CD14, CD64, CD11b, lysozyme) would support monocytic lineage.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have scant cytoplasm, may contain Auer rods and are MPO-strong, whereas monoblasts have abundant cytoplasm and are NSE-positive with weak or absent MPO.
BPDCN also causes skin infiltration but blasts are CD4+/CD56+/CD123+/TCF4+ and lack NSE, lysozyme and CD14.
Lymphoma cells are CD45+ B or T lymphocytes lacking monocytic markers and usually lack circulating monoblasts.

ddx.dx: Periorbital cellulitis or hematoma (e.g., amyloidosis purpura)
ddx.vs: Inflammatory or hemorrhagic swelling lacks a blast population on smear or tissue sampling.

61012.recognize_zh: 多格骨髓抹片：A–B 可見大量核偏位、細胞質藍染、核旁有淡染區的不典型漿細胞；C–F 另有核型不規則的紅血球母細胞、顆粒缺失或分葉不足的嗜中性球、極巨大多核分葉的巨核細胞與雙核巨核細胞，提示骨髓瘤合併多系發育不良（MDS）。
features: Panels A-B: sheets of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin, basophilic cytoplasm, some with visible nucleoli and binucleation
Panel B: hypogranular neutrophil admixed with plasma cells
Panel C: late erythroblast with irregular, lobulated nucleus (nuclear budding)
Panel D: degranulated neutrophilic precursors and small hypogranular neutrophils with abnormal nuclear segmentation
Panel E: giant megakaryocyte with abundant cytoplasm and a large hyperlobated/fragmented nucleus
Panel F: megakaryocyte with two separate round nuclei (binucleated)
61012.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show a marked increase in plasma cells, many with eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin, basophilic cytoplasm and occasional binucleation or nucleoli (panels A-B, reported at 76% of cells).
