In addition there is dysplasia in the other lineages: a hypogranular neutrophil (B), an erythroblast with an irregular lobulated nucleus (C), degranulated and hyposegmented neutrophil lineage cells (D), a giant megakaryocyte with a bizarre hyperlobated nucleus (E), and a binucleated megakaryocyte with widely separated nuclei (F). Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with concomitant myelodysplasia; confirmation of the concurrent MDS rests on cytogenetics and molecular studies given that dysplasia can be reactive or therapy-related.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with reactive dyserythropoiesis
ddx.vs: Mild reactive dyspoiesis is common in marrow-replacing myeloma, but multilineage dysplasia in >=10% of cells with a myeloid clonal mutation (TET2 here) supports a true coexisting MDS.
Reactive plasma cells are mature, polyclonal, usually <10-20% and lack binucleation/nucleoli and a monoclonal paraprotein.
Requires prior cytotoxic therapy (e.g., alkylators or lenalidomide), whereas this dysplasia is present at diagnosis.
B12/folate deficiency causes nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and hypersegmented neutrophils rather than hypogranular hyposegmented neutrophils, and corrects with vitamin replacement.

60948.recognize_zh: 低倍血片中血小板明顯稀少，散在紅血球碎片（裂片細胞 schistocytes、頭盔細胞）與小球形紅血球，符合微血管病變溶血性貧血；結合腎衰竭與 ADAMTS13 正常，指向非典型溶血性尿毒症候群。
features: Scattered schistocytes including helmet cells and small triangular fragments
Occasional microspherocytes and mild anisocytosis
Markedly reduced platelets, with one small platelet clump in the field
Neutrophils present and morphologically unremarkable
No red cell agglutination or nucleated red cells in this field
60948.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows red cells with mild anisocytosis and scattered fragmented forms, including helmet cells and small triangular schistocytes, with occasional microspherocytes. Platelets are markedly decreased, with only a few single platelets and one small clump. White cells present are segmented neutrophils without toxic or dysplastic changes. In the setting of DAT-negative hemolysis, acute kidney injury and normal ADAMTS13 activity, the findings are consistent with a thrombotic microangiopathy, favoring atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome; schistocyte quantification at high power is recommended.

ddx.vs: The smear is identical, so severely reduced ADAMTS13 activity (<10%) is required to separate TTP from HUS.
DIC shows similar schistocytes but with prolonged PT/APTT and low fibrinogen, which were normal here.
AIHA shows spherocytes and polychromasia with a positive DAT but lacks significant schistocytes.
Morphology overlaps, and separation depends on gestational timing, liver enzymes and hypertension.

60884.recognize_zh: 骨小樑旁的骨髓被纖維化間質取代，其中有核深染、核質比高的腫瘤細胞排成巢狀與條索，被粉紅色膠原纖維隔分開，幾乎不見正常造血細胞，符合轉移性小圓藍細胞腫瘤（肺泡型橫紋肌肉瘤）。
features: Marrow adjacent to a bony trabecula replaced by desmoplastic fibrous stroma containing tumor
Nests, cords and trabeculae of small-to-medium round blue cells with hyperchromatic oval nuclei, scant cytoplasm and nuclear crowding
Collagenous fibrovascular septa separating tumor nests, focally with slit-like spaces
Scattered adipocytes; residual hematopoiesis minimal in this field
Scattered mitotic/apoptotic figures within tumor nests
60884.describe_en: Intermediate-power hematoxylin and eosin-stained bone marrow biopsy shows extensive replacement of the intertrabecular marrow by a metastatic neoplasm. Nests and cords of small to medium-sized round blue cells with hyperchromatic, crowded oval nuclei and scant cytoplasm are separated by collagenous fibrous septa, imparting a nested architecture; residual normal hematopoiesis is scant. The adjacent bony trabecula is unremarkable. Findings are consistent with metastatic small round blue cell tumor; in conjunction with desmin and myogenin positivity, this represents metastatic alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma.

ddx.vs: Neuroblastoma shows neuropil and rosettes, with synaptophysin/PHOX2B positivity and myogenin negativity.
Ewing sarcoma grows as sheets of uniform cells with fine chromatin and is CD99/NKX2.2 positive.

ddx.dx: Metastatic medulloblastoma or desmoplastic small round cell tumor
ddx.vs: DSRCT shows nests in desmoplastic stroma too, but co-expresses keratin, desmin (dot-like) and WT1 C-terminus with EWSR1::WT1 fusion and is myogenin negative.
Leukemic infiltrates are diffuse and discohesive rather than sharply nested, and are CD45/CD34/TdT or MPO positive.

60820.recognize_zh: CD3 染色顯示大量小至中型 T 細胞呈膜狀陽性、密集散布於背景，右側可見未染色的大型細胞聚集區（腫瘤細胞為 CD3 陰性），說明腫瘤大細胞位於豐富的反應性 T 細胞背景中。
features: Numerous small to medium lymphocytes with strong membranous/cytoplasmic CD3 staining
Dense background T-cell population, more sparse toward the right side of the field
Unstained larger cells with pale vesicular nuclei in areas between positive T cells, indicating CD3-negative neoplastic cells
No convincing CD3 expression in the large atypical cells
60820.describe_en: CD3 immunohistochemistry highlights numerous small to medium-sized reactive T cells with membranous staining throughout the background, while larger atypical cells in the intervening areas are negative. The neoplastic large cells therefore do not express the T-cell marker CD3, and the T-cell-rich background is consistent with the mixed inflammatory milieu seen in gray zone lymphoma. This stain supports a B-cell lineage for the large cells when interpreted with CD20 and Oct-2.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma with Hodgkin-like cells
ddx.vs: In PTCL the atypical medium-to-large cells themselves are CD3-positive (often with aberrant loss of other T-cell antigens), whereas here the large cells are CD3-negative.
THRLBCL also has abundant CD3+ T cells but contains only scattered single large B cells lacking CD15/CD30, rather than clusters and sheets.
cHL shows CD3+ T-cell rosettes around HRS cells, but the large cells lack CD20 and Oct-2 expression.

60756.recognize_zh: 腹水抹片中一顆中型淋巴樣細胞，核圓、染色質細緻略粗、可見小核仁，細胞質深藍色並佈滿大小一致的清楚圓形空泡（脂質空泡），是 Burkitt 淋巴瘤細胞在體液中的典型外觀。
features: Isolated medium-sized lymphoid cell with high N:C ratio
Round nucleus with finely clumped chromatin and small nucleoli
Rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing multiple sharply punched-out clear vacuoles
Sparsely cellular background with debris; a short chain of small dark cocci adjacent to a pale degenerated cell (lower left), likely a contaminant
Only one tumor cell in the field, so overall cellularity and presence of apoptotic debris cannot be assessed
60756.describe_en: Cytospin of ascitic fluid shows an isolated medium-sized lymphoid cell with a round nucleus, finely clumped chromatin, small nucleoli and a rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing numerous discrete clear vacuoles. The background is sparsely cellular with debris; a short chain of cocci adjacent to a degenerated cell is also present and should be correlated with fluid culture to exclude infection versus contamination. Only a single abnormal cell is seen in this field. Findings are suggestive of involvement by Burkitt lymphoma, to be confirmed by flow cytometry (CD10+, surface light chain-restricted B cells) and MYC rearrangement studies.

ddx.vs: Cells are larger and more pleomorphic with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, and cytoplasmic vacuoles are usually less uniform.
Mesothelial cells have dense cytoplasm with a peripheral clear skirt and 'windows', and macrophages have abundant pale foamy cytoplasm with low N:C ratio.
Blasts have finer chromatin with scant, usually non-vacuolated cytoplasm and are TdT positive with absent surface immunoglobulin.
Forms cohesive three-dimensional clusters with mucin vacuoles and cytokeratin/claudin-4 positivity rather than discohesive lymphoid cells.

60628.recognize_zh: 橫紋肌纖維之間被大量中型、核形不規則且深染的異常淋巴細胞浸潤並分隔破壞；免疫染色膜陽性（T 細胞標記）、另一核染色陽性，PCR 凝膠顯示本病例擴增出 HTLV-1 pX 區段（327 bp），符合成人 T 細胞白血病／淋巴瘤侵犯肌肉。
features: Skeletal muscle with residual eosinophilic myofibers separated and effaced by a dense infiltrate of atypical lymphoid cells
Medium to large lymphoid cells with hyperchromatic, irregular to convoluted nuclei and scant cytoplasm; some perinuclear clearing
Immunostain B: strong membranous staining of nearly all infiltrating cells (T-cell marker)
Immunostain D: nuclear positivity in most tumor cells
PCR gel: this case shows a strong 327-bp HTLV-1 pX band with the 547-bp internal control, matching the positive control; negative control shows only the internal control band
60628.describe_en: Sections of skeletal muscle (H&E) show extensive infiltration by medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with hyperchromatic, irregular and convoluted nuclei, dissecting between and destroying muscle fibers. Immunohistochemistry demonstrates diffuse membranous positivity for a T-cell marker and nuclear positivity for a second marker in most tumor cells. PCR of tumor DNA amplifies the HTLV-1 pX region (327 bp) as in the positive control, with an intact internal control band. Findings are consistent with extensive muscular involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma; monoclonal integration of HTLV-1 proviral DNA (Southern blot) confirms the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS can look identical but is HTLV-1 negative by serology and proviral DNA testing.
Myositis shows a polyclonal infiltrate of small cytologically bland lymphocytes with myofiber necrosis and regeneration rather than sheets of atypical cells.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving muscle
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are CD20/PAX5-positive and lack T-cell markers and HTLV-1.

ddx.dx: Rhabdomyosarcoma or other small round cell tumor
ddx.vs: Rhabdomyosarcoma expresses desmin and myogenin and is negative for lymphoid markers.

60628.stain: H&E; IHC (membranous and nuclear markers); PCR gel

60692.recognize_zh: 上排 MRI 顯示右側顳葉病灶在數週內由小片高訊號（A、B）擴大為顯影增強、具占位效應的腫塊（C）；下排 H&E（D）為瀰漫片狀的不成熟母細胞浸潤，E、F 免疫染色呈瀰漫陽性，符合顱內骨髓性肉瘤（myeloid sarcoma）快速進展。
features: Axial MRI (A, B): hyperintense signal in the right anterior temporal region that enlarges on follow-up
Post-contrast MRI (C): large enhancing extra-axial/temporal mass with mass effect on the brainstem region
H&E (D): diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-sized immature cells with round to oval nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Immunostains (E, F): diffuse positivity in the tumor cells; specific markers not labeled and low color fidelity limits interpretation
No cohesive or glandular architecture to suggest carcinoma
60692.describe_en: Serial axial MRI images (panels A-C) show a right temporal lesion that progresses from a subtle area of hyperintensity to a large contrast-enhancing mass with mass effect over approximately four weeks. Biopsy (H&E, panel D) shows a diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate of monotonous immature mononuclear cells with fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm, without cohesive epithelial architecture. The accompanying immunostains (panels E and F) show diffuse tumor-cell positivity, but the antigens are not labeled and the image color quality limits interpretation. In the appropriate context with myeloid marker expression (e.g., MPO, CD33, CD117), findings are consistent with intracranial myeloid sarcoma.

ddx.dx: Primary CNS diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: PCNSL shows larger cells with an angiocentric pattern and expresses CD20/PAX5, whereas myeloid sarcoma expresses MPO, CD33, CD117, or lysozyme.
Morphologically similar blasts, but TdT/CD3 or CD19/CD79a positivity with MPO negativity indicates lymphoblastic lineage.
Meningioma is also an enhancing extra-axial dural mass on MRI but histologically shows whorls of spindled meningothelial cells rather than discohesive blasts.

ddx.dx: Small round blue cell tumors (e.g., metastatic small cell carcinoma)
ddx.vs: Small cell carcinoma shows nuclear molding, crush artifact, and keratin/neuroendocrine marker positivity, not myeloid antigens.

60436.recognize_zh: 幼童淋巴結結構被中型不典型淋巴球與粉紅色細胞質的組織球混合瀰漫取代（A、B），這些 T 細胞 CD3、CD8 陽性、granzyme B 呈細胞毒性顆粒狀染色，EBER 原位雜交（F）可見大量紅色核陽性；「兒童＋全身多器官侵犯＋EBV 陽性細胞毒性 T 細胞」指向兒童系統性 EBV 陽性 T 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Complete effacement of lymph node architecture by a diffuse infiltrate (A)
Medium-sized atypical lymphocytes with irregular nuclear folds, mature chromatin and occasional small nucleoli, admixed with numerous histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm (B)
Diffuse membranous/cytoplasmic CD3 (C) and CD8 (D) positivity in the atypical cells
Granular cytoplasmic granzyme B staining indicating a cytotoxic phenotype (E)
EBER in situ hybridization with numerous positive (red-purple) nuclei across the infiltrate (F)
60436.describe_en: Lymph node sections show complete architectural effacement by a diffuse infiltrate of medium-sized atypical lymphocytes with irregular, folded nuclei, mature chromatin and occasional small nucleoli, intermixed with abundant histiocytes. The atypical cells are positive for CD3 and CD8 and show granular cytoplasmic granzyme B, indicating a cytotoxic T-cell phenotype. EBER in situ hybridization is positive in a large proportion of the lymphoid cells. In a 2-year-old with fever, generalized lymphadenopathy and multiorgan involvement, findings are consistent with systemic EBV-positive T-cell lymphoma of childhood.

ddx.vs: IM shows partially preserved architecture with a polymorphous immunoblastic reaction, predominantly EBER-positive B cells and a clinically self-limited course, rather than effacement by monotonous EBER-positive CD8+ cytotoxic T cells.
EBV-HLH shows histiocytic hemophagocytosis with fewer atypical T cells; clonality studies and the degree of cytologic atypia and effacement help separate it, and the entities overlap clinically.

ddx.dx: Chronic active EBV disease, T/NK type
ddx.vs: CAEBV has a protracted course (>3 months) with a less aggressive, often polymorphous infiltrate, whereas systemic EBV+ T-cell lymphoma is fulminant with monomorphic effacement.
ENKTL is usually CD56-positive and surface CD3-negative with angiocentric necrosis at nasal/extranodal sites in adults, rather than CD8+ nodal disease in a young child.

60436.stain: H&E; IHC: CD3, CD8, granzyme B; ISH: EBER

60372.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中單一顆芽細胞，核質比極高、染色質細緻、細胞質僅剩一圈薄藍邊且無顆粒，背景紅血球可見標靶細胞與少量碎片樣細胞，符合復發 B-ALL 的循環淋巴芽細胞。
features: Single circulating blast about twice the diameter of an RBC
Very high N:C ratio with a scant rim of basophilic, agranular cytoplasm
Round to oval nucleus with fine chromatin; nucleoli not prominent
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic vacuoles
Background red cells with numerous target cells, occasional fragments/poikilocytes; platelets not evident in this field
60372.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single circulating blast with a very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and a thin rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm, without Auer rods. The red cells show numerous target cells and occasional fragmented or irregular forms, and platelets are not evident in this field. Blast lineage cannot be determined morphologically; in the context of known CD34+ B-ALL, findings are consistent with circulating lymphoblasts of relapsed B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: An agranular myeloblast can be indistinguishable; flow cytometry showing myeloid markers without CD19/CD79a is required.
Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant cytoplasm and coarser chromatin rather than fine blastic chromatin.
Hematogones rarely circulate, are smaller, and show a maturing immunophenotype without aberrant antigen expression.

60180.recognize_zh: 左圖可見一顆循環芽細胞（核大、染色質細緻、胞質少而偏藍）緊鄰一顆有核紅血球；右圖的嗜中性球胞質顆粒很少、細胞核分葉異常呈團塊狀。紅血球大小不一並有淚滴狀與橢圓形，符合伴隨過多芽細胞的MDS。
features: Circulating blast: large cell with high N:C ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and a thin rim of basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Adjacent nucleated red blood cell (orthochromatic normoblast) with a dense round pyknotic nucleus
Dysplastic neutrophil (right panel) with hypogranular pale cytoplasm and abnormally clumped, irregularly separated nuclear lobes
Marked anisopoikilocytosis of red cells with teardrop cells, elliptocytes and occasional fragments
Platelets are sparse in both panels
60180.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (composite of two fields) shows marked red cell anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop cells, elliptocytes and occasional fragmented forms, and platelets are sparse. A circulating blast with finely dispersed chromatin and scant basophilic agranular cytoplasm is present adjacent to a nucleated red blood cell. A neutrophil in the second field is dysplastic, with hypogranular cytoplasm and abnormally clumped, irregularly segmented nuclear lobes. In the setting of cytopenias with 4% circulating blasts, the findings are consistent with myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts (former RAEB-1, 2–4% blood blasts), pending marrow evaluation.

ddx.vs: PMF also shows teardrop cells, nRBCs and occasional blasts, but typically with splenomegaly, JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation and marrow fibrosis rather than prominent neutrophil dysplasia.
Myelophthisis gives a leukoerythroblastic smear with teardrops but neutrophils are not dysplastic and tumor cells are found on marrow biopsy.
AML is diagnosed with ≥20% blasts in blood or marrow, whereas only rare blasts are present here.
Megaloblastic anemia shows macro-ovalocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils with normal granulation rather than hypogranular neutrophils and circulating blasts.

60116.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片低到中倍可見大量單形性芽細胞取代正常造血，細胞大小從小到中型，核圓或有凹陷、染色質細緻、細胞質稀少淡藍無顆粒；成熟顆粒球與紅系前驅細胞明顯稀少。
features: Hypercellular smear dominated by a monotonous population of small to medium-sized blasts
High N:C ratio with round, oval or indented nuclei
Fine chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm without Auer rods
Marked reduction of maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors; rare eosinophil
60116.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and composed predominantly of a monotonous population of small to medium-sized blasts, with marked reduction of normal maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements. The blasts have a high N:C ratio, round to indented nuclei, fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant pale agranular cytoplasm. No Auer rods are seen. Morphology is consistent with lymphoblastic leukemia, and in conjunction with flow cytometry supports T-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Morphology cannot separate B- from T-lymphoblasts; lineage assignment requires flow cytometry (CD19/CD79a vs cytoplasmic CD3).
Hematogones are small with homogeneous condensed chromatin, show a maturation continuum on flow, and do not form near-total sheets.
AML blasts usually show some granules or Auer rods and are MPO or CD13/CD33/CD117 positive.

60052.recognize_zh: 高倍周邊血液抹片中整片只看到一顆小淋巴球，沒有嗜中性球，也幾乎找不到血小板，紅血球大致正常大小與顏色、無碎片或球形細胞；這種「空蕩、無特異變化」的抹片反映全血球低下，符合以再生不良性貧血表現的 PNH，需以流式偵測 GPI 缺失族群確認。
features: Only a single small mature lymphocyte in the field; no neutrophils or monocytes (leukopenia)
Platelets markedly decreased, essentially absent in this field
Red cells largely normocytic and normochromic with mild anisocytosis and a rare echinocyte
No schistocytes, spherocytes, polychromasia, nucleated red cells, or blasts
No dysplastic or leukoerythroblastic features
60052.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at higher power shows a paucity of leukocytes, with only a single small mature lymphocyte in the field and no neutrophils or monocytes. Platelets are markedly decreased. Red cells are predominantly normocytic and normochromic with mild anisocytosis and a rare echinocyte, without schistocytes, spherocytes, polychromasia, nucleated red cells, or circulating blasts. Findings are consistent with pancytopenia without specific morphologic abnormalities; in the setting of marrow aplasia, this is compatible with aplastic anemia with a PNH clone, which requires confirmation by high-sensitivity flow cytometry (FLAER/CD24/CD14 on granulocytes and monocytes, CD59 on red cells).

ddx.vs: Shows polychromasia and reticulocytosis with elevated LDH and hemoglobinuria, and a large GPI-deficient clone, whereas this smear lacks evidence of active hemolysis.
Often shows macrocytosis, hypogranular or pseudo-Pelger neutrophils, or circulating blasts, none of which are seen here.
Presents with pancytopenia and monocytopenia but shows circulating cells with circumferential hairy cytoplasmic projections and splenomegaly.
Pancytopenia is accompanied by macro-ovalocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils.

26964.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中數顆紅血球（含多染性紅血球）布滿粗大、藍紫色的嗜鹼性點彩（coarse basophilic stippling），右上插圖的骨髓鐵染色見有核紅血球內含藍黑色鐵顆粒環繞核周——嗜鹼性點彩合併環狀鐵粒母細胞，配合人格改變，提示鉛中毒。
features: Panel A (PB): several red cells with coarse, evenly dispersed blue-purple basophilic stippling, some in polychromatic cells
Mild anisopoikilocytosis with scattered target cells and polychromasia
Normal-appearing segmented neutrophil and adequate platelets
Panel B (Prussian blue, BM aspirate): erythroblasts (red counterstained nuclei) with blue-black siderotic granules, some arranged around the nucleus
Extracellular/macrophage iron granules also present in panel B
26964.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (A) shows mild anisopoikilocytosis with polychromasia and several erythrocytes containing coarse, evenly distributed basophilic stippling; the neutrophil and platelets appear unremarkable. A Prussian blue-stained bone marrow aspirate (B) shows erythroid precursors with increased coarse siderotic granules, some positioned perinuclearly in keeping with ring sideroblasts. In a patient with anemia and neuropsychiatric change, findings are consistent with lead poisoning (acquired sideroblastic anemia due to inhibition of ALA dehydratase and ferrochelatase and of pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase); a blood lead level and zinc protoporphyrin should be measured.

ddx.vs: This hereditary hemolytic anemia also shows prominent coarse basophilic stippling, but blood lead is normal and ring sideroblasts are not a feature.
Thalassemias show uniform microcytosis, target cells and usually finer stippling, with abnormal hemoglobin studies and normal lead levels.
MDS-RS shows dimorphic red cells, dysplasia and ≥15% ring sideroblasts (≥5% with SF3B1), without toxic exposure or elevated lead.
Pappenheimer bodies are few, clustered at the cell periphery and Prussian blue-positive, whereas basophilic stippling is diffuse RNA aggregates that are iron-negative.

15124.recognize_zh: 股骨頭骨髓腔內仍被成片大型組織球佔滿，細胞質豐富淡粉紅、帶細纖維狀皺紙樣紋理，核小而偏位，即高雪氏細胞（Gaucher cells）；表示長期酵素替代療法（ERT）後骨骼內仍可殘留高雪氏細胞浸潤。
features: Diffuse sheets of large histiocytes replacing the marrow space
Abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with fine fibrillary 'wrinkled tissue paper' texture
Small, round, eccentric or central dark nuclei
Fragment of eosinophilic lamellar bone trabecula and scattered fat spaces
Normal hematopoietic elements essentially absent in this field; no necrosis or inflammation evident
15124.describe_en: Histologic section of bone from a femoral head (H&E) shows the marrow space diffusely replaced by sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm having a fibrillary, wrinkled tissue paper appearance and small eccentric nuclei. A fragment of lamellar bone trabecula and scattered fat spaces are present, while normal hematopoietic elements are essentially absent in this field. No necrotic bone or inflammatory infiltrate is evident here. Findings are consistent with persistent Gaucher cell infiltration of the skeletal marrow, illustrating that bone marrow involvement may persist despite 15 years of enzyme replacement therapy.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells are morphologically identical but occur with an underlying neoplasm or high cell turnover and normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
MAC-laden histiocytes can mimic Gaucher cells but contain numerous acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
Niemann-Pick cells have finely vacuolated, bubbly cytoplasm rather than fibrillary striations, with sphingomyelinase deficiency.
Crystal-storing histiocytes contain eosinophilic needle-like immunoglobulin crystals and are associated with a light chain-restricted plasma cell neoplasm.

14740.recognize_zh: 腎移植後長期免疫抑制、全血球減少的患者，周邊血可見核扭曲／雙葉的大型不典型單核細胞（A），骨髓觸片（touch imprint）出現成群的大型細胞，核大且扭曲、染色質開放、核仁明顯、細胞質嗜鹼帶空泡並有核分裂，符合移植後淋巴增生疾患（PTLD）之瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: PB: large atypical mononuclear cell with convoluted/folded nucleus and moderate basophilic cytoplasm beside a neutrophil
BM touch imprint: cohesive-appearing clusters of large cells, 2-4 times the size of a small lymphocyte
Large convoluted nuclei with open chromatin and prominent nucleoli
Moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm with small clear vacuoles
Mitotic figure and apoptotic debris among the neoplastic cells
PB red cells show crenation (echinocytes), and platelets are sparse
14740.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows occasional large atypical mononuclear cells with convoluted nuclei and moderate basophilic cytoplasm; platelets are decreased and red cells show crenation. The bone marrow touch imprint shows clusters of large atypical lymphoid cells with convoluted nuclei, open chromatin, prominent nucleoli, and moderately abundant basophilic, focally vacuolated cytoplasm, with a mitotic figure present. In a renal transplant recipient on long-term immunosuppression, and with CD20-positive large cells on biopsy, findings are consistent with monomorphic post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder, diffuse large B-cell lymphoma type. EBER in situ hybridization is recommended.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma clusters are truly cohesive with molded nuclei and cytokeratin positivity, whereas PTLD cells are lymphoid, CD45+ and CD20+.
Polymorphic PTLD shows a mixture of small lymphocytes, plasma cells, and immunoblasts rather than sheets of uniformly large transformed cells.
Monoblasts have folded nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm but express CD33/CD64/lysozyme and lack CD20.
Reactive immunoblasts are scattered singly within a polymorphous background rather than forming clusters that efface marrow with a clonal B-cell population.

13268.recognize_zh: 高倍下可見大型、多核或呈花圈樣（wreath-like）核的異型細胞，其中一顆細胞質內含數顆被吞入的紅血球；周圍混有小淋巴球與漿細胞，提示 ALCL 腫瘤細胞吞噬紅血球。
features: Large atypical cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm and multiple nuclei arranged in a wreath-like pattern
Nuclei vesicular to coarse with distinct nucleoli; some kidney-shaped forms
One multinucleated tumor cell contains several engulfed red cells; another large cell also contains red cell material
Background of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid cells
Eosinophilic fibrous stroma in the lower right corner
13268.describe_en: Section (H&E) at high power shows scattered large atypical cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, multiple or wreath-like nuclei, and prominent nucleoli, set in a background of small lymphocytes and plasma cells. One multinucleated atypical cell contains several phagocytosed red cells, and a second large cell contains intracytoplasmic red cell material. Findings are consistent with tumor-cell erythrophagocytosis in anaplastic large cell lymphoma; CD30 and ALK immunohistochemistry are required to confirm tumor-cell identity.

ddx.vs: HRS cells are CD15+/PAX5 weak+ and lack ALK and T-cell/cytotoxic markers, and they rarely show erythrophagocytosis.
Benign hemophagocytes have small bland single nuclei rather than atypical wreath-like multinucleation.
Megakaryocytes have a single hyperlobated nucleus and are CD61/CD42b-positive, not CD30-positive.
Histiocytic sarcoma is CD163/CD68-positive and CD30/ALK-negative.

9492.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中有許多大型、核圓、染色質較開放並帶明顯核仁的細胞（巨大原紅血球樣），配合免疫染色 c、d 的陽性與 e 的陰性對照，提示小病毒 B19（parvovirus B19）感染骨髓；圖中未標註各抗體，須對照原文判讀。
features: Cellular marrow with preserved fat and bony trabecula at low power (a)
Increased large cells with round nuclei, open chromatin and prominent nucleoli, consistent with enlarged (giant) pronormoblasts (b)
Scattered large cells with membranous/cytoplasmic immunostaining in panel c
Diffuse nuclear/cytoplasmic immunostaining of many marrow cells in panel d
Panel e shows essentially negative staining (negative marker or control)
Eosinophilic intranuclear viral inclusions are not clearly resolved at this magnification
9492.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows a cellular marrow adjacent to a bony trabecula with preserved fat. At higher power there are increased large cells with round nuclei, vesicular chromatin, and prominent nucleoli, resembling enlarged pronormoblasts. Immunohistochemical panels show membranous/cytoplasmic staining of scattered large cells (c), diffuse staining of many marrow cells (d), and a negative stain (e); the antibodies are not labeled in the figure. Characteristic glassy intranuclear inclusions are not definitively resolved at this resolution. Findings are suggestive of parvovirus B19 infection of the marrow, which should be confirmed by parvovirus B19 immunohistochemistry, in situ hybridization, or serum PCR.

ddx.vs: Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of clonal erythroid blasts with TP53 abnormalities and lacks viral inclusions or parvovirus B19 staining.
Myeloblasts are MPO/CD34/CD117 positive and E-cadherin/glycophorin negative, unlike parvovirus-infected erythroid precursors.

ddx.dx: Metastatic tumor or large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These form cohesive or diffuse sheets with lineage-specific markers (keratin, CD20, CD30) rather than erythroid antigens.
Megaloblastic change shows the full range of enlarged erythroid precursors with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and giant metamyelocytes, not an arrest at giant pronormoblasts.

12948.recognize_zh: 單顆中性球的核葉上附有兩個由細柄相連的小圓形鼓槌狀突起（drumsticks），每個代表一條失活的 X 染色體（Barr body）；兩個鼓槌提示有兩條失活 X，本例核型為 XXX。
features: Mature neutrophil with a multilobed nucleus bearing two small round drumstick appendages attached by thin stalks
Drumsticks are about 1.5 µm, dense and solidly stained
Neutrophil cytoplasm pale with fine granules
Background red cells show echinocytic crenation (likely drying/storage artifact)
One red cell contains a small ring-like inclusion or artifact; no platelets in the field
12948.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil with a multilobed nucleus carrying two discrete drumstick-shaped appendages, each composed of a dense round head attached by a thin chromatin stalk. The background red cells show diffuse crenation, most likely an artifact. A single drumstick represents the inactive X chromosome in normal females; two drumsticks in a single neutrophil suggest the presence of two inactive X chromosomes, as in 47,XXX or other supernumerary X karyotypes, and karyotyping is required for confirmation.

ddx.dx: Sessile nodules or small nuclear tags
ddx.vs: Sessile nodules lack a thin stalk, and small tags or clubs are not the uniform ~1.5 µm round heads of true drumsticks.

ddx.dx: Hypersegmented neutrophil with small detached lobes
ddx.vs: Detached lobes in megaloblastic change are larger, variable in size and connected by longer chromatin bridges.

ddx.dx: Acquired dysplastic nuclear projections in MDS/MPN
ddx.vs: Dysplastic neutrophils may show multiple abnormal appendages with hypogranulation, so normal karyotype studies separate acquired from constitutional causes.

ddx.dx: Howell-Jolly body or platelet overlying the nucleus
ddx.vs: An overlying body lies in a different focal plane and is not connected to a nuclear lobe by a stalk.

12692.recognize_zh: 左圖前臂皮膚可見沿毛囊分布的出血點（perifollicular hemorrhage），提示維生素 C 缺乏的壞血病（「英國水手吃萊姆」的典故）；右圖骨髓抹片中大量紅血球前驅細胞體積增大、染色質細緻篩狀且核質發育不同步，為巨母細胞性造血，常與同時存在的葉酸缺乏有關。
features: Clinical photo: forearm with numerous perifollicular petechial/hemorrhagic macules along hair follicles
BM aspirate: numerous enlarged erythroid precursors with finely dispersed, sieve-like (open) chromatin
BM aspirate: nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, with immature nuclei in cells with increasingly hemoglobinized cytoplasm
BM aspirate: basophilic proerythroblasts and polychromatophilic megaloblasts with occasional binucleation/irregular nuclear forms
Occasional granulocytic precursor with abnormal (possibly hypersegmented or fragmented) nucleus in the upper field
12692.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the forearm shows numerous perifollicular hemorrhagic macules, a characteristic cutaneous sign of scurvy. The accompanying bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular with erythroid predominance; erythroid precursors are enlarged with finely dispersed, sieve-like chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, with scattered irregular or binucleate forms. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic erythropoiesis in a patient with scurvy, most likely reflecting concomitant dietary folate deficiency (vitamin C is required to maintain folate in its reduced form); serum folate, vitamin B12, and ascorbic acid levels should be obtained.

ddx.vs: Pure erythroid leukemia has sheets of proerythroblasts with TP53 abnormalities and does not resolve with vitamin replacement.
MDS shows megaloblastoid change with ring sideroblasts or clonal cytogenetics and normal vitamin levels.
B12 deficiency gives identical marrow morphology but is separated by low B12 with elevated methylmalonic acid.

ddx.dx: Senile purpura or thrombocytopenic petechiae (for the skin lesion)
ddx.vs: These are not follicle-centered and lack corkscrew hairs or gingival changes.

12564.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中出現中大型的母細胞，胞質深藍（強嗜鹼性）並有多個清楚的脂質空泡（vacuoles），核染色質細緻、有核仁，這種「深藍胞質＋空泡」是 Burkitt 淋巴瘤白血病期的典型線索。
features: Medium to large blasts with round to slightly irregular nuclei and finely stippled chromatin
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with multiple sharply punched-out clear vacuoles
Visible nucleoli in some cells; one cell with an indented/folded nucleus
Blasts occur singly and in small clusters (panel B)
Background with mild anisocytosis and very few platelets
12564.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating medium- to large-sized blasts, singly and in small clusters. The blasts have round to folded nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and visible nucleoli, and a rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing multiple discrete clear vacuoles. Red cells show mild anisocytosis and platelets are markedly decreased. Findings are consistent with leukemic involvement by Burkitt lymphoma; confirmation requires flow cytometry (CD10+, CD19+, surface light chain restricted, TdT-negative) and demonstration of MYC rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts usually have scant, less basophilic cytoplasm without prominent vacuoles and are TdT-positive, surface Ig-negative, whereas Burkitt cells are TdT-negative with surface light chain restriction and MYC rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leukemic / high-grade B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger and more pleomorphic with lower Ki-67 and often BCL2 expression, and high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC/BCL2 rearrangements needs FISH to exclude.
Monoblasts have abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and folded nuclei and are MPO/NSE or CD64/CD14 positive, unlike B-lineage Burkitt cells.

5844.recognize_zh: 背景為核仁明顯的芽細胞；左側一個芽細胞的細胞質空泡內含一顆深染的小圓核（被吞噬的有核細胞），右下角另有類似的吞噬現象，屬芽細胞吞噬血球（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Many medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio and round to indented nuclei
Fine chromatin with distinct nucleoli
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm, some with cytoplasmic blebs
Blast (left) containing an engulfed small cell with a dense round nucleus inside a vacuole; a second similar phagocytic blast at lower right
Background of red cells and scattered small dark nucleated cells (likely late erythroid precursors or lymphocytes)
5844.describe_en: Smear shows numerous blasts with fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm. At least two blasts contain engulfed nucleated cells with dense pyknotic-appearing nuclei within clear vacuoles, consistent with hemophagocytosis by leukemic blasts. The phagocytic cells retain blast nuclear features rather than those of mature macrophages. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with blast hemophagocytosis; flow cytometry for monocytic markers and cytogenetics for t(8;16) KAT6A::CREBBP are recommended.

ddx.vs: HLH macrophages are large mature cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and bland condensed nuclei, and the background lacks a blast population.
Morphology overlaps (monocytic blasts with hemophagocytosis); the diagnosis requires demonstrating the KAT6A::CREBBP rearrangement.
Emperipolesis is seen within mature megakaryocytes and the engulfed cells are intact and non-degenerated.
Cannibalistic tumor cells are cohesive and non-hematopoietic, lacking the dispersed blast population seen here.

3092.recognize_zh: 紅血球之間一顆無核小顆粒體，直徑約紅血球的四分之一，中央有紫色嗜天青顆粒（granulomere）、周邊為淡染透明區（hyalomere），就是正常血小板。
features: Small anucleate cell fragment about one quarter the diameter of adjacent red cells
Central cluster of purple azurophilic granules (granulomere)
Pale, faintly staining peripheral cytoplasm (hyalomere)
Round outline without pseudopods or clumping
Surrounding normocytic, normochromic red cells
3092.describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a single platelet lying between normocytic red cells. It is round and approximately one quarter of a red cell diameter, with a central granulomere of purple azurophilic granules and a pale peripheral hyalomere. There is no platelet clumping, giant form or hypogranularity. Findings are consistent with a morphologically normal platelet.

ddx.vs: Giant platelets approach or exceed the diameter of a red cell, as in Bernard-Soulier syndrome or MYH9-related disorders, whereas this platelet is about one quarter of a red cell.
Gray platelets are pale and lack azurophilic granules, unlike the distinct central granulomere here.

1940.recognize_zh: 畫面中有數顆巨大的後骨髓細胞/帶狀核（giant metamyelocytes/bands），馬蹄形核卻染色質疏鬆，旁邊還有核分葉過多的嗜中性球及核染色質呈篩網狀的巨母紅血球，是巨母紅血球性貧血的經典組合。
features: Giant metamyelocytes and giant band forms with large horseshoe-shaped nuclei and open chromatin
Hypersegmented neutrophil with multiple nuclear lobes
Megaloblastic erythroid precursors with finely stippled chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony
Granulocytic cytoplasm with fine granules, larger than expected for stage
Background of normochromic red cells, some macrocytic
1940.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular cluster containing giant metamyelocytes and band forms with large, horseshoe-shaped nuclei whose chromatin is more open than expected for their stage of maturation. A hypersegmented neutrophil is present, and erythroid precursors are enlarged with finely stippled, sieve-like chromatin, reflecting nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony in both lineages. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia.

ddx.vs: MDS typically shows hypogranular pseudo-Pelger-Huet neutrophils and dysplastic megakaryocytes, and giant metamyelocytes are uncommon; B12/folate levels are normal.
Morphology is indistinguishable; medication history and normal vitamin levels discriminate.
Reactive metamyelocytes are normal-sized with condensed chromatin and toxic granulation rather than giant forms with open chromatin.

2772.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中一群彼此緊貼、核互相擠壓變形（nuclear molding）的圓形腫瘤細胞，細胞質極少、染色質細緻，旁邊還有散在的相同細胞，這種黏著成團且核相嵌的型態提示轉移性神經母細胞瘤。
features: Cohesive cluster of intermediate-sized round cells with nuclear molding
High N:C ratio with scant pale blue cytoplasm forming thin rims
Round to oval nuclei with finely granular, evenly distributed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Nearby single and paired cells of identical morphology
Adjacent pink granular smudged material and red cells with rouleaux-like stacking (likely thick smear area)
2772.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive cluster of intermediate-sized round cells with high N:C ratios, scant pale blue cytoplasm, and round to oval nuclei with finely granular chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Nuclear molding between adjacent cells is prominent, and similar cells are present singly and in pairs nearby. Pink granular smudged material lies adjacent to the cluster. Well-formed rosettes are not identified. Findings are consistent with metastatic undifferentiated neuroblastoma; immunohistochemical confirmation is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leukemic blasts are discohesive and do not show nuclear molding; myeloblasts may contain granules or Auer rods.
Proerythroblasts have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear clear zone and surround a central macrophage, and are accompanied by maturing erythroid precursors.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small cell carcinoma or Ewing sarcoma
ddx.vs: These show similar molding, so age, clinical history and IHC (keratin, CD99/NKX2.2, PHOX2B) are required.

2708.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中央有一顆大型組織球，細胞質豐富、淡藍灰色，內部布滿彎曲的條紋如「皺摺衛生紙」（crumpled tissue paper），核小且偏心，周圍為正常骨髓細胞，是典型的高雪氏細胞（Gaucher cell）。
features: Large histiocyte with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm
Cytoplasm with fibrillary, striated texture resembling crumpled tissue paper
Small, eccentric, round nucleus with condensed chromatin
Surrounding normal marrow elements: maturing myeloid precursors, segmented neutrophils, lymphocytes, and erythroid precursors
No cytoplasmic vacuolation or foamy change
2708.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large histiocyte with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm containing fine, wavy fibrillary striations imparting a crumpled tissue paper appearance, with a small eccentric nucleus. The surrounding marrow contains maturing granulocytic precursors, segmented neutrophils, lymphocytes, and erythroid precursors without increased blasts. No foamy or sea-blue histiocytes are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a Gaucher cell; glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay or GBA gene testing is recommended to distinguish Gaucher disease from pseudo-Gaucher cells.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, MAC infection)
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells look similar but occur with a background neoplasm, hemolysis or infection and have normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Niemann-Pick cells have finely vacuolated foamy (soap-bubble) cytoplasm rather than fibrillary striations.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete deep blue granules on Wright-Giemsa rather than pale fibrillary cytoplasm.

1236.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中單獨一顆母細胞：核大、染色質細緻、核偏一側並有淺凹，胞質中等量藍色且無明顯顆粒；周邊紅血球多呈鋸齒狀（crenated，屬塗片假影）。單一循環母細胞只能說明白血病細胞入血，無法單憑此圖判定「有成熟」。
features: Single circulating blast, roughly twice the diameter of a red cell
High N:C ratio with finely dispersed chromatin and a slightly indented, eccentric nucleus
Moderate rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm without visible granules or Auer rods
Background red cells show diffuse crenation (echinocytic artifact)
No other leukocytes or platelet clumps in the field
1236.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single circulating blast approximately twice the size of a red cell, with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, a slightly indented eccentric nucleus, and a moderate rim of pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm. No Auer rods are seen. Background red cells show widespread crenation, most consistent with a drying artifact. A circulating blast indicates a leukemic process, but maturation cannot be assessed on this field; classification as acute myeloid leukemia with maturation depends on the marrow differential and lineage studies.

ddx.vs: A single agranular blast cannot be assigned lineage by morphology, and flow cytometry is required.
Reactive lymphocytes have more condensed chromatin and abundant cytoplasm that scallops around adjacent red cells, rather than fine blast chromatin with a high N:C ratio.
Leukoerythroblastosis shows rare blasts with nucleated red cells and left-shifted granulocytes, requiring marrow examination to distinguish from acute leukemia.

1172.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片細胞量多，幾乎整個視野都是含粉紫顆粒的成熟中顆粒球（骨髓球、後骨髓球、帶狀核），而深藍細胞質、圓形深染核的紅血球前驅細胞很少，代表骨髓球/紅血球比（M:E ratio）上升。
features: Cellular aspirate dominated by granulocytic precursors at all stages of maturation
Many myelocytes, metamyelocytes and band neutrophils with granular pink-lilac cytoplasm
Erythroid precursors (round dense nuclei, deep blue to polychromatic cytoplasm) are relatively few
Orderly maturation without an obvious excess of blasts at this power
Occasional eosinophil precursors; thick crenated red cell background
1172.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and composed predominantly of granulocytic cells showing orderly maturation from myelocytes to segmented neutrophils. Erythroid precursors are relatively scarce, resulting in an increased myeloid-to-erythroid ratio. Blasts are not increased at this magnification, and no significant dysplasia is evident. Findings are consistent with an increased M:E ratio, which may reflect granulocytic hyperplasia (infection, inflammation, G-CSF) or erythroid hypoplasia; a CML or other MPN should be excluded clinically and by blood counts.

ddx.vs: CML shows a markedly increased M:E ratio with myelocyte and segmented neutrophil peaks, basophilia and small hypolobated megakaryocytes, confirmed by BCR::ABL1.
PRCA has almost absent erythroid precursors with normal granulopoiesis, so the increased M:E is due to erythroid loss rather than myeloid expansion.
AML with maturation shows 20% or more blasts, often with Auer rods, which are not seen here.

1108.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中散布許多大細胞，胞質充滿粉紅色圓球狀包涵體（Russell bodies），核被擠壓成小而不規則，箭頭指的就是這種 Mott 細胞。
features: Numerous large cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm filled with globular inclusions
Small, compressed, eccentric or central irregular nuclei (arrows)
Mulberry/grape-like appearance of cytoplasmic globules (Russell bodies)
Background of small lymphocytes and hematopoietic cells between fat spaces
Scattered extravasated red cells
1108.describe_en: H&E section of bone marrow shows a cellular interstitial infiltrate between fat spaces containing numerous large cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm distended by globular inclusions, compressing small irregular nuclei (arrows). These represent plasma cells with Russell bodies (Mott cells), admixed with small lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with a lymphoplasmacytic/plasmacytic process with Mott cell change, as may be seen in marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation; light chain restriction should be assessed.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have homogeneous or finely granular cytoplasm with large multilobated nuclei, not cytoplasm packed with discrete globules.
Myeloma forms sheets of atypical plasma cells without a lymphocytic component; CD138 and light chain IHC quantify and characterize the clone.
Storage histiocytes have striated 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than round refractile immunoglobulin globules.

4244.recognize_zh: 組織切片以大量成熟脂肪細胞為主，脂肪之間夾雜三系造血細胞（箭頭處），看起來像骨髓但沒有骨小樑，這是腎上腺骨髓脂肪瘤（adrenal myelolipoma）的特徵；此視野未見腎上腺皮質。
features: Predominance of mature adipocytes of variable size
Interspersed hematopoietic elements between fat cells (arrow), including dark erythroid and granulocytic precursors
Scattered larger cells consistent with megakaryocytes
Absence of bony trabeculae
Hemorrhage and loose red cells at the edge of the section; no adrenal cortex in this field
4244.describe_en: Tissue section shows a lesion composed of mature adipose tissue admixed with foci of trilineage hematopoietic elements (arrow), including erythroid and myeloid precursors and occasional megakaryocytes. No bony trabeculae are present, and no cytologic atypia or lipoblasts are identified. Adrenal cortical tissue is not included in this field. In the appropriate adrenal location, findings are consistent with adrenal myelolipoma.

ddx.vs: EMH usually forms paraspinal or organ-based hematopoietic tissue without a dominant fat component and occurs with chronic anemia or marrow failure.
Liposarcoma shows atypical hyperchromatic stromal cells and MDM2 amplification, and lacks trilineage hematopoiesis.
Marrow tissue is situated between bony trabeculae, which are absent in this section.

4116.recognize_zh: 兩個巨大的巨噬細胞細胞質內吞入大量有核細胞（紅血球前驅細胞、嗜中性球）與碎屑，周圍散在細胞質豐富、染色質細緻的大型單核母細胞，即急性單核母細胞白血病合併噬血現象。
features: Two large macrophages with abundant pale, foamy/vacuolated cytoplasm engulfing numerous nucleated cells (erythroid precursors, granulocytes) and nuclear debris
Dark pigment/debris granules within macrophage cytoplasm
Surrounding large blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and moderate blue-gray cytoplasm (monoblasts)
Scattered intact RBCs and a few erythrocytes adjacent to macrophages
Background thick smear area with RBC distortion
4116.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows two large macrophages with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing numerous phagocytosed nucleated hematopoietic cells, including erythroid precursors and granulocytes, as well as nuclear debris and pigment. The surrounding cells include large blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and moderate amounts of gray-blue cytoplasm, morphologically consistent with monoblasts. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis in the setting of acute monoblastic leukemia; correlation with HLH diagnostic criteria (ferritin, soluble CD25, cytopenias) is recommended.

ddx.dx: Leukemic blast with erythrophagocytosis (e.g., AML with t(8;16) KAT6A::CREBBP)
ddx.vs: In t(8;16) AML the blasts themselves ingest RBCs, whereas here benign macrophages engulf whole nucleated cells.
Infection-associated HLH lacks the population of monoblasts and may show intracellular organisms such as LD bodies.
True hemophagocytosis shows cells entirely enclosed within a single macrophage cytoplasmic boundary.

4180.recognize_zh: 低倍皮膚切片中，表皮下方整個真皮被緻密、均勻的細胞浸潤填滿並包圍毛囊附屬器，表皮本身未受侵犯；這種結節狀瀰漫真皮浸潤符合皮膚肥大細胞瘤，但此倍率看不到細胞細節，需高倍與 tryptase/CD117 確認。
features: Dense, diffuse, sheet-like dermal infiltrate filling the entire dermis at low power
Infiltrate extends up to the dermoepidermal junction beneath a thin intact epidermis
Entrapped hair follicle/adnexal structures within the infiltrate
Monotonous appearance without follicle formation or necrosis
Cytologic detail not assessable at this magnification
4180.describe_en: Low-power view of a skin biopsy shows a dense, diffuse, monotonous infiltrate occupying the full thickness of the dermis and extending to the dermoepidermal junction, entrapping adnexal structures. The overlying epidermis is thin but not involved. Cytologic features cannot be assessed at this magnification. In the setting of mastocytosis, this pattern is consistent with a cutaneous mastocytoma or nodular cutaneous mastocytosis; high-power examination and tryptase or CD117 immunostaining are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Leukemic or lymphomatous infiltrates contain atypical blasts or lymphocytes that are CD45/CD43/MPO or lymphoid-marker positive and tryptase-negative.
JXG contains foamy histiocytes and Touton giant cells at higher power and is CD68/CD163-positive.
LCH shows grooved nuclei with eosinophils, frequent epidermotropism and CD1a/langerin positivity.

4052.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指是數個含粗大深紫色顆粒的肥大細胞（mast cell），有的顆粒分布不均、細胞質邊緣呈淡色或延伸，混雜在骨髓的顆粒球系前驅細胞之間，提示全身性肥大細胞增生症。
features: Several medium to large cells (arrows) with round to oval nuclei obscured by coarse dark purple metachromatic granules
Uneven granule distribution with partially hypogranular, pale cytoplasm in some mast cells (atypical forms)
One cell with dense, deeply basophilic granules filling the cytoplasm (lower right arrow)
Background of maturing granulocytic precursors, eosinophils, lymphocytes and erythroid cells
No sheets of blasts identified in this field
4052.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mixed hematopoietic population with maturing myeloid and erythroid precursors. Several mast cells are highlighted, some large with coarse purple granules that are unevenly distributed and focally sparse, suggesting atypical morphology. The mast cells lie singly and in a small loose group rather than in a single aggregate. In the appropriate context (KIT D816V, tryptase, CD25/CD2 expression, and biopsy aggregates), findings are suggestive of systemic mastocytosis.

ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are round, evenly and densely granulated, and scattered singly, lacking spindle or hypogranular atypia and CD25/CD2 expression.
Basophils are smaller with segmented nuclei and granules overlying the nucleus, and are CD123/CD203c-positive but not strongly KIT/tryptase-positive like mast cells.
Requires mast cells to constitute at least 20% of aspirate nucleated cells, usually immature, which is not seen in this field.
Promyelocytes have azurophilic granules with a perinuclear Golgi zone and are MPO strongly positive, while mast cell granules are metachromatic and tryptase-positive.

3860.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中出現成群、比周圍正常造血細胞大很多的淋巴樣大細胞，核有凹陷或分葉、染色質細緻並見核仁，胞質深藍並帶小空泡，和旁邊的小淋巴球、骨髓球形成明顯大小落差，符合瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤（DLBCL）侵犯。
features: Clusters of large atypical lymphoid cells, several times the size of small lymphocytes
Irregular, cleaved to lobated nuclei (including a multilobated 'cloverleaf' cell) and round nuclei
Open, finely granular chromatin with one or more visible nucleoli
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm with fine vacuoles; many fragile cells with bare cytoplasmic fragments
Residual hematopoiesis: myelocyte with granules, orthochromatic normoblasts, small lymphocytes
3860.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows aggregates of large atypical lymphoid cells that dwarf the residual small lymphocytes and erythroid precursors. The cells have irregular, cleaved or multilobated nuclei with open chromatin and nucleoli, and a moderate amount of basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm; numerous cytoplasmic fragments indicate cell fragility. Background hematopoietic elements, including granulated myelocytes and normoblasts, are present. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, to be confirmed by flow cytometry and core biopsy immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have finer chromatin with less nuclear lobation and may show granules or Auer rods, and they are CD34/CD117/MPO-positive rather than CD19/CD20-positive.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with molding and are cytokeratin-positive and CD45-negative.
ALCL hallmark cells have horseshoe-shaped nuclei with a paranuclear eosinophilic region and are CD30-positive with T-cell or null phenotype.
Plasmablasts have eccentric nuclei with a paranuclear hof and are CD138/MUM1-positive and CD20-negative.

3732.recognize_zh: 低倍下紅血球聚成大片、形狀不規則的團塊（agglutination），而不是排成一串的錢串狀（rouleaux）；團塊之間的背景很乾淨，單一顆嗜中性球夾在其中。臨床上若是低溫下採血或抹片出現這種凝集，要想到冷凝球蛋白（cryoglobulin）或冷凝集素。
features: Large, irregular three-dimensional clumps of red cells (agglutinates) rather than linear stacks
Clumps of variable size separated by clear, cell-poor background
Individual RBCs within clumps are normocytic without obvious fragmentation
Scattered platelets in the background; a single segmented neutrophil
No visible extracellular precipitate or crystalline material at this magnification
3732.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows extensive red cell agglutination, with large, irregular, grape-like clumps of erythrocytes separated by clear background. The aggregates are haphazard rather than linear, arguing against rouleaux. Leukocytes and platelets are present in small numbers without distinctive abnormalities. No discrete cryoprecipitate is identified at this magnification. In the appropriate clinical setting (e.g., chronic hepatitis C), findings are consistent with cold-dependent agglutination related to cryoglobulins.

ddx.vs: Morphologically identical agglutinates; distinguished by a positive DAT (C3), high-titer cold agglutinin and reversal on warming, whereas cryoglobulins are demonstrated by serum precipitation at 4 °C.
Rouleaux form linear coin-stack chains in the thin area, not irregular three-dimensional clumps.

ddx.dx: Warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia with agglutination
ddx.vs: Warm AIHA shows prominent spherocytes and polychromasia, and agglutination does not disperse on warming the specimen to 37 °C.

3796.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結中，副皮質區（paracortex）被大片淡粉紅色、細胞較稀疏的區域擴張，把深藍色的小淋巴球區推擠成不規則的島狀，淋巴結構仍保留、被膜完整；這種淡染副皮質結節是皮膚病性淋巴結病變（dermatopathic lymphadenopathy）的低倍線索。
features: Preserved nodal architecture with intact capsule and subcapsular region
Marked expansion of the paracortex by broad pale-staining zones
Pale zones contain loosely arranged cells with abundant pale cytoplasm (histiocytes/interdigitating dendritic cells)
Residual dark small-lymphocyte areas and a follicle-like aggregate compressed between pale zones
Rare dark pigment focus; melanin cannot be confirmed at this magnification
3796.describe_en: Lymph node section at low power shows preserved architecture with an intact capsule. The paracortex is expanded by broad, pale-staining nodular zones composed of cells with abundant pale cytoplasm, consistent with histiocytes and interdigitating/Langerhans-type dendritic cells, which separate residual dark lymphoid areas and follicles. No sheets of atypical cells or effacement are seen at this power; pigment-laden macrophages cannot be reliably assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with dermatopathic lymphadenopathy; clinical history of chronic dermatitis and exclusion of early mycosis fungoides involvement are recommended.

ddx.dx: Lymph node involvement by mycosis fungoides/Sezary syndrome
ddx.vs: MF involvement shows clusters or sheets of atypical cerebriform lymphocytes in the paracortex with partial effacement and clonal TCR rearrangement, rather than only reactive histiocytes and dendritic cells.
LCH shows sinus-based infiltrates of grooved Langerhans cells with abundant eosinophils and necrosis, whereas dermatopathic change is paracortical with scattered melanophages.
cHL shows Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells (CD30+/CD15+) in a mixed inflammatory background, which are absent in dermatopathic lymphadenopathy.

3668.recognize_zh: 骨髓顆粒內有眾多脂肪空泡與穿插其間的紡錘形間質細胞、淡藍色纖維狀基質，並散在深黑至黃綠色的含鐵血黃素顆粒與折光性碎屑，屬骨髓正常間質成分（脂肪細胞、網狀細胞、含鐵巨噬細胞）。
features: Marrow particle with abundant adipocytes forming clustered clear vacuoles
Interspersed spindle-shaped stromal cells with oval nuclei and pale blue fibrillary cytoplasm
Dark black and yellow-green coarse granules consistent with hemosiderin within macrophages
Refractile yellow-brown amorphous material adjacent to fat, likely hemosiderin or artifact
Admixed hematopoietic cells with oval nuclei along the stromal network
3668.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a particle composed of numerous adipocytes with an interlacing network of spindle-shaped stromal cells and pale blue fibrillary matrix. Scattered dark black to yellow-green coarse granules, consistent with hemosiderin within macrophages, and refractile yellow-brown material are present. Admixed hematopoietic cells show no atypia, and no cohesive tumor clusters or granulomas are identified. Findings represent normal marrow stromal elements, including adipocytes, reticular cells, and iron-laden macrophages; storage iron should be graded on Prussian blue stain.

ddx.vs: Tumor forms cohesive clusters with nuclear pleomorphism and molding rather than a bland stromal network.
Gaucher cells are large histiocytes with wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm and a small eccentric nucleus, unlike spindle stromal cells.
Spindle mast cells contain metachromatic purple granules and show tryptase/CD117/CD25 positivity.
Granulomas show cohesive epithelioid histiocytes with elongated slipper-shaped nuclei, sometimes with giant cells, rather than adipocyte-rich stroma.

3540.recognize_zh: 低倍下骨髓細胞密度高，可見大量核圓深染的紅血球系前驅細胞與各階段成熟的顆粒球，並散在少數大型、細胞質深藍的早期前驅細胞，呈現移植後造血恢復中的三系再生樣貌。
features: Hypercellular aspirate smear with numerous hematopoietic cells
Many small round cells with dense dark nuclei, consistent with erythroid precursors
Maturing granulocytic series including bands and segmented neutrophils
Scattered larger immature cells with deep blue cytoplasm, likely early erythroid or myeloid precursors
Fat vacuoles and background granular debris
3540.describe_en: Low-power view of the bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with active trilineage-appearing hematopoiesis, including abundant erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei and maturing granulocytic elements to segmented neutrophils. Scattered larger immature precursors with deeply basophilic cytoplasm are present but do not form sheets. Megakaryocytes are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with regenerating hematopoiesis after bone marrow transplantation; residual disease assessment requires a differential count and flow cytometric or molecular studies.

ddx.vs: Relapse would show a monotonous population or sheets of blasts rather than a mixed maturing erythroid and granulocytic population.
MDS requires dysplasia in at least 10% of cells in a lineage, which cannot be assessed at this low magnification.

ddx.dx: Erythroid hyperplasia due to hemolysis or blood loss
ddx.vs: Reactive erythroid hyperplasia looks similar and is distinguished only by clinical context rather than morphology.

3476.recognize_zh: 骨髓顆粒（particle）中紅色箭頭處可見一條線狀結構，由細長梭形核的內皮細胞沿淡藍色纖維狀基質排列而成，周圍混有各階段造血細胞與脂肪空泡，為正常的骨髓微血管，不要誤認為腫瘤細胞團。
features: Cellular marrow particle with fat spaces and trilineage hematopoietic cells
Linear structure (red arrow) formed by elongated spindle-shaped endothelial nuclei
Endothelial nuclei aligned in parallel along a pale blue fibrillar stromal strand
Surrounding maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes appear normal
No cohesive clusters of atypical non-hematopoietic cells
3476.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle containing fat spaces and maturing trilineage hematopoietic cells. A linear structure (red arrow) composed of elongated, spindle-shaped nuclei aligned along a pale blue fibrillar strand traverses the particle, representing a capillary with its endothelial lining. The surrounding hematopoietic cells show normal maturation, and no cohesive atypical cell clusters are present. This is a normal marrow capillary, a stromal element that should not be mistaken for metastatic tumor.

ddx.vs: Tumor clusters consist of cohesive, round to polygonal cells with large atypical nuclei and nuclear molding, not flattened spindle nuclei aligned along a vessel wall.
Neoplastic mast cells are spindle-shaped but contain metachromatic purple granules and form aggregates, whereas endothelial cells are agranular.
Stromal fragments are disorganized sheets of spindle cells with collagen and are accompanied by atypical megakaryocytes, rather than a single tubular structure.

3348.recognize_zh: 免疫染色中散佈的大型腫瘤細胞呈棕色強陽性，且核與細胞質同時著色，而周圍小淋巴細胞與組織細胞為陰性，符合 NPM1::ALK 融合典型的 ALK 核質雙染型態。
features: Large atypical cells with strong brown staining of both nucleus and cytoplasm
Positive cells scattered individually and in small clusters among negative background cells
Some positive cells have irregular or kidney-shaped nuclear outlines
Background small lymphocytes and stromal/endothelial cells are negative (blue hematoxylin counterstain)
Specific antibody not labeled; nuclear-plus-cytoplasmic pattern is most compatible with ALK
3348.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a lymph node shows numerous large atypical cells with strong nuclear and cytoplasmic brown staining, distributed singly and in small clusters, while background small lymphocytes and stromal cells are negative. The antibody is not labeled in the image; the combined nuclear and cytoplasmic pattern is characteristic of ALK protein expression driven by the NPM1::ALK fusion. Findings are consistent with ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma, in conjunction with CD30 positivity and hallmark cell morphology.

ddx.dx: ALK-positive ALCL with variant ALK partner
ddx.vs: Non-NPM1 partners (e.g., TPM3, ATIC, CLTC) yield cytoplasmic-only or granular ALK staining without nuclear positivity.
ALK-negative ALCL has similar CD30-positive hallmark cells but is completely ALK negative by IHC.
ALK+ LBCL shows granular cytoplasmic ALK (CLTC::ALK), plasmablastic morphology and is CD138/EMA positive and CD30 negative.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30/CD15 positive and ALK negative with weak PAX5 expression.

3220.recognize_zh: 脂肪細胞之間有一條細長管道，管壁有扁長的內皮細胞核，管腔內排列多顆紅血球，這就是骨髓中的微血管（capillary），屬正常結構。
features: Narrow vascular channel running between adipocytes
Flattened, elongated endothelial nuclei lining the channel
Luminal red blood cells, several with crescent or fixation-distorted shapes
Thin eosinophilic cytoplasmic/stromal septa surrounding large empty fat vacuoles
No hematopoietic cells or inflammatory infiltrate in this field
3220.describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow section (H&E) shows a thin-walled capillary coursing between adipocytes. The channel is lined by flattened, elongated endothelial nuclei and contains a row of intraluminal red blood cells, some showing crescentic fixation artifact. The surrounding fat cells and delicate stromal septa are unremarkable, and no hematopoietic or inflammatory cells are present in the field. Findings represent a normal marrow capillary.

ddx.vs: Erythrophagocytosis shows red cells within a macrophage cytoplasm around a single oval macrophage nucleus, not within a lumen lined by flattened endothelial cells.
Yeasts are smaller, uniform, with a clear halo or capsule and a nuclear dot, whereas these have the size and hemoglobin color of red cells.

3284.recognize_zh: 中央一顆巨大的巨核細胞，分葉核周圍的細胞質中可見完整的小型造血細胞（深染的小圓核細胞）位於細胞質內，並非重疊在表面，這就是 emperipolesis（細胞穿行現象）。
features: Large megakaryocyte with multilobated nucleus and abundant granular cytoplasm
Intact small hematopoietic cells with dense nuclei within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm
Engulfed cells retain intact nuclei and are not degraded (distinct from phagocytosis)
Surrounding hematopoietic cells in a cellular aspirate particle
Green-tinged background staining artifact
3284.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with a multilobated nucleus and abundant granular cytoplasm containing several intact small hematopoietic cells with dense, well-preserved nuclei. The internalized cells show no evidence of degradation, consistent with emperipolesis rather than phagocytosis. The surrounding marrow particle is cellular; the background shows green-tinged staining artifact. Emperipolesis is a nonspecific finding seen in reactive marrows and myeloproliferative neoplasms, particularly primary myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: Hemophagocytic macrophages have a single oval nucleus and contain degraded, often vacuole-enclosed cells, whereas megakaryocytes have a lobulated nucleus and intact internalized cells.

ddx.dx: Cells overlying a megakaryocyte on the smear
ddx.vs: Overlying cells lie in a different focal plane and lack a surrounding clear cytoplasmic space.
Rosai-Dorfman emperipolesis occurs in large S100-positive histiocytes with a single vesicular nucleus, not in megakaryocytes.

3156.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中的顆粒（particle）以脂肪空泡與淡粉紅色基質為主，只夾雜稀疏的深染細胞，周圍全是紅血球背景，看不到成群的造血細胞，提示治療後骨髓低細胞性。
features: Single marrow particle composed predominantly of fat vacuoles and stromal meshwork
Sparse hematopoietic cells scattered within the particle
Dark-staining stromal and endothelial nuclei forming a network
Small refractile golden-brown deposits consistent with hemosiderin
Background of peripheral blood red cells with very few nucleated cells
3156.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a particle composed largely of fat vacuoles and stromal elements with only sparse hematopoietic cells. Scattered golden-brown pigment consistent with hemosiderin is present. The trails and background consist mostly of red cells with very few nucleated marrow elements. Findings are consistent with a hypocellular marrow, in keeping with post-therapy aplasia; cellularity should be confirmed on the trephine biopsy.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia shows a similarly fatty, stroma-rich marrow, so distinction depends on clinical history of therapy and exclusion of other causes rather than aspirate morphology.
A hemodiluted aspirate lacks marrow particles, whereas here the particle itself is fatty and hypocellular; biopsy cellularity is the definitive measure.
Hypoplastic myeloid neoplasms retain dysplastic or blast populations and clonal cytogenetic abnormalities, which need to be sought on cellular areas and ancillary studies.

3028.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量形態一致的中型芽細胞，核質比極高、細胞質極少、染色質均勻細緻、核仁不明顯，細胞質內沒有顆粒或 Auer 小體，符合兒童前 B 淋巴芽細胞白血病（pre-B ALL）。
features: Monotonous population of small-to-medium blasts, about 1.5-2 times RBC diameter
Very high N:C ratio with only a thin rim of cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with homogeneous, finely dispersed chromatin
Nucleoli inconspicuous; no cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods
Occasional dark peripheral staining artifact at cell borders; few residual myeloid cells
3028.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a predominance of monotonous small-to-medium sized blasts that replace normal hematopoietic elements. The blasts have a very high N:C ratio, scant agranular cytoplasm, round to slightly indented nuclei with finely dispersed homogeneous chromatin, and inconspicuous nucleoli. No Auer rods are seen; a few residual myeloid cells are present at the periphery of the field. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; flow cytometry is required to confirm B-lineage (CD19, CD10, TdT) and to exclude myeloid blasts.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 blasts can be agranular but typically are larger with more cytoplasm and nucleoli, and lack B-cell markers while expressing CD13/CD33/CD117.
Hematogones are a heterogeneous maturing B-cell continuum with smudged chromatin and orderly antigen expression on flow, not a marrow-replacing monotonous blast population.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and are surface-immunoglobulin positive and TdT negative.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor (neuroblastoma)
ddx.vs: Neuroblastoma forms clusters or rosettes and is CD45-negative, whereas ALL blasts are dispersed and CD45 dim/positive with TdT.

2964.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑間幾乎被造血細胞填滿、脂肪很少，屬於高細胞密度骨髓；此倍率無法看出顆粒球成熟停滯，需高倍或抹片確認。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow filling intertrabecular spaces with few fat vacuoles
Anastomosing bony trabeculae without significant remodeling
Scattered megakaryocytes visible as larger cells
Cellular detail not resolvable at low power
2964.describe_en: Low-power bone marrow core biopsy shows markedly hypercellular marrow filling the spaces between anastomosing bony trabeculae, with few residual fat vacuoles and scattered megakaryocytes. Cytologic detail and myeloid maturation cannot be evaluated at this magnification. A hypercellular marrow is compatible with the myeloid hyperplasia and maturation arrest of severe congenital neutropenia but is nonspecific without higher-power and aspirate evaluation.

ddx.vs: Reactive hyperplasia shows complete maturation to segmented neutrophils at high power.
MPN shows clustered atypical megakaryocytes and reticulin fibrosis with a driver mutation.
Leukemia shows effacement by monotonous blasts at high power.

2900.recognize_zh: 中低倍 LAP 染色：視野裡大量中性球只見紅色分葉核，幾乎沒有藍色顆粒，僅一兩顆有少量藍色，代表 LAP 分數偏低（如 CML）。
features: Increased number of neutrophils with red-counterstained lobulated nuclei
Almost all neutrophils lack blue cytoplasmic granules (score 0)
Only one or two cells with faint blue reaction product
Unstained red cell aggregates in background
2900.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear stained for leukocyte alkaline phosphatase shows numerous neutrophils, nearly all of which lack blue cytoplasmic reaction product and display only red-counterstained nuclei. Rare cells show faint positivity. This pattern corresponds to a markedly reduced LAP score, as classically seen in chronic myeloid leukemia (and in PNH), in contrast to the high scores of leukemoid reactions.

ddx.vs: Reactive neutrophilia shows most neutrophils with 2+ to 4+ blue granules and a high LAP score.
A concurrently run positive control with strongly reactive neutrophils is required to exclude a false-low result from old or improperly fixed smears.

2644.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片幾乎被一群形態單一的中大型母細胞占滿，核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質少至中等且呈藍色並帶小空泡，正常造血細胞罕見，配合病史符合復發的急性淋巴母細胞白血病（ALL）。
features: Sheets of medium to large blasts replacing the field
High N:C ratio with round to slightly irregular nuclei
Finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous to small
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm, several cells with small punched-out vacuoles
No cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods identified
Few residual normal elements (a segmented neutrophil, an erythroid precursor)
2644.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a markedly increased population of medium to large blasts occupying most of the field, with few residual maturing hematopoietic elements. The blasts have high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to slightly indented nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm; a subset contains small cytoplasmic vacuoles. No granules or Auer rods are seen. Morphology alone cannot assign lineage, but in the stated clinical context findings are consistent with relapsed B- or T-lymphoblastic leukemia; flow cytometry and MRD studies are required for confirmation.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: Granule- and Auer rod-negative myeloblasts can look identical, so MPO cytochemistry and flow cytometry (CD13/CD33/CD117 vs CD19/CD79a/cytoplasmic CD3) are needed to separate them.
Burkitt cells show deeply basophilic cytoplasm with abundant sharply defined lipid vacuoles in nearly every cell and are surface immunoglobulin positive, TdT negative, with MYC rearrangement.
Hematogones are smaller with homogeneous condensed chromatin, lack vacuoles, and show an orderly maturation spectrum on flow cytometry rather than a sheet-like aberrant blast population.

2580.recognize_zh: 厚區抹片中央一大團血小板聚集，含大小不一、部分為巨大血小板（giant platelets）的顆粒狀紫藍色團塊，符合原發性血小板增多症（ET）的血小板大量增加與形態異質性。
features: Large aggregate of platelets with marked variation in size, including giant platelets
Platelets with purple granular centers (granulomeres) and pale blue hyalomere
Two dense, dark round bodies within the aggregate of uncertain nature (possibly pyknotic nuclei)
Thick area of smear with red cells showing refractile drying artifact
Individual white cell morphology not assessable in this field
2580.describe_en: Thick area of a smear shows a large aggregate of platelets with marked anisocytosis, including giant platelets, set among red cells with prominent refractile drying artifact. Two dense round dark bodies within the aggregate cannot be further characterized. The field suggests marked thrombocytosis with platelet size heterogeneity; accurate platelet morphology is best assessed in the thin monolayer area. Findings are compatible with essential thrombocythemia in the appropriate clinical and molecular context (JAK2, CALR or MPL mutation).

ddx.vs: Reactive thrombocytosis usually has normal-sized platelets without giant forms and lacks JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations and clustered hyperlobated megakaryocytes on biopsy.
In vitro clumping gives a falsely low platelet count and resolves in citrate tubes, whereas ET shows a genuinely elevated count.
A megakaryocyte fragment has continuous cytoplasm with a nucleus, whereas a platelet aggregate is composed of discrete individual platelets.

2452.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片以中型原始細胞為主，染色質細緻、胞質少且無顆粒，部分核形不規則，並可見一個有絲分裂像與壓碎的細胞；殘存少數中性球與有核紅血球，符合急性淋巴母細胞白血病（T 細胞系需流式確認）。
features: Predominance of medium-sized blasts with round to irregular nuclei
Fine chromatin with small nucleoli in some cells
Scant to moderate pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Mitotic figure present; several crushed/smudged cells
Residual segmented neutrophil and dense erythroid precursors
2452.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is composed predominantly of medium-sized blasts with round to irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and scant agranular cytoplasm. A mitotic figure and several crushed cells are present, reflecting a proliferative, fragile population. Residual neutrophils and erythroid precursors are few. No Auer rods are identified. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; T-lymphoblastic lineage requires immunophenotypic confirmation.

ddx.vs: Distinguished only by immunophenotype (B-lineage markers instead of cytoplasmic CD3).
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and are surface Ig positive and TdT negative.
Myeloblasts show more cytoplasm, possible granules or Auer rods and MPO positivity.

2196.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆比紅血球大一倍多的細胞，核呈摺疊／腎形、染色質細緻如花邊，細胞質豐富、灰藍色如毛玻璃並帶數個空泡，是典型的單核球；背景紅血球呈棘狀（crenation）人工假象。
features: Large leukocyte about 2 times RBC diameter
Folded, lobulated to reniform nucleus
Lacy, finely reticulated chromatin without nucleoli
Abundant gray-blue ground-glass cytoplasm with fine azurophilic dusting
Several cytoplasmic vacuoles
Background crenated RBCs (echinocytes, likely drying artifact)
2196.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large leukocyte with a folded, lobulated nucleus, lacy chromatin, and no visible nucleoli. The cytoplasm is abundant, gray-blue with a ground-glass texture, and contains several small vacuoles. Surrounding red cells show crenation consistent with a drying or storage artifact. Findings are consistent with a normal mature monocyte.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more condensed chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm that scallops around adjacent RBCs rather than gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm.
Promonocytes have finer, more open chromatin with visible nucleoli and delicate nuclear folds, indicating immaturity.
Neutrophil precursors have pink-lilac cytoplasm with specific granules and coarser chromatin, not gray-blue ground-glass cytoplasm.

2068.recognize_zh: 抹片中為中型、形態一致的淋巴樣細胞，核圓、染色質細緻，細胞質呈深藍色並布滿清楚的圓形小空泡（lipid vacuoles），這種深藍細胞質加空泡正是 Burkitt 淋巴瘤細胞在抹片上的典型特徵。
features: Medium-sized monotonous lymphoid cells with round nuclei and finely stippled chromatin
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing multiple sharply punched-out clear vacuoles
Vacuoles also overlie nuclei and lie in the background
Several cells show small nucleoli; high N:C ratio
Occasional neutrophil and a stretched stromal/crush strand for size comparison
2068.describe_en: Cytologic preparation shows a monotonous population of medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, finely stippled chromatin and small nucleoli. The cytoplasm is deeply basophilic and contains numerous sharply defined clear lipid vacuoles, some overlying the nucleus. Occasional neutrophils are present in the background. Findings are consistent with Burkitt lymphoma/leukemia cells (FAB L3 morphology); immunophenotyping and MYC rearrangement studies are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger and more pleomorphic, and prominent cytoplasmic vacuolation is less uniform; Ki-67, BCL2 and MYC FISH help separate them.
Lymphoblasts have scant, only mildly basophilic cytoplasm and are TdT/CD34 positive, whereas Burkitt cells are TdT negative with surface light-chain expression.

ddx.dx: Acute monocytic or myeloid leukemia with vacuoles
ddx.vs: Vacuolated myeloid or monocytic blasts have gray-blue cytoplasm with granules or folded nuclei and are MPO or nonspecific esterase positive.

1812.recognize_zh: 低倍免疫組織化學染色：骨髓腔幾乎全被呈棕色膜狀陽性的細胞瀰漫填滿，右側骨小樑染成藍色；在此病例中陽性標記最可能為 B 細胞標記（如 CD20），顯示淋巴瘤瀰漫性浸潤骨髓，但圖上未標示抗體名稱。
features: Diffuse, strong brown membranous/cytoplasmic immunoreactivity in the majority of marrow cells
Marrow spaces packed with positive cells in a diffuse (not nodular or interstitial) pattern
Bony trabecula with blue counterstain on the right
Near absence of negative background hematopoietic cells and fat
Antibody not specified; low magnification limits cytologic assessment
